Mishneh Torah, Testimony 10:
Harshaim pesulin leedut min hattora shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 1)</small> "al tashet yadcha im rasha lihyot ed chamas" mippi hashshemua lamdu al tashet rasha ed. vaafillu ed kasher sheyyodea bachavero shehu rasha veen haddayyanim makkirin risho asur lo lehaid immo af al pi shehu edut emet. mippene shemmitztaref immo venimtza ze hakkasher heshit yado im harasha ad shennitkabbela eduto. veen tzarich lomar ed kasher shehu yodea beedut lachavero veyada shehaed hashsheni immo ed sheker sheasur lo lehaid shenneemar al tashet yadcha im rasha: 
E zehu rasha kol sheavar avera shechayyavin aleha malkot zehu rasha ufasul. shehare hattora kara lamchuyyav malkot rasha shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 2)</small> "vehaya im bin hakkot harasha". veen tzarich lomar mechuyyav mitat bet din shehu pasul shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar la lo)</small> "asher hu rasha lamut": 
Avar avera shechayyavin aleha malkot min hattora hare ze pasul min hattora. veim haya hachiyyuv shebbah middivrehem hare ze pasul middivrehem. ketzad. achal besar behema bechalav o sheachal nevelot ushekatzim vechayyotze bahen ben leteavon ben lehacheis. o shechillel et yom tov harishon. o shellavash shaatnez shehu shua o tavuy o nuz. hare ze pasul leedut min hattora. aval im achal besar of bechalav. o shechillel yom tov sheni shel galuyyot. o shellavash beged tzemer sheavad bo chut shel pishtan vechayyotze bo. hare hu pasul middivrehem. uchevar maninu kol avera shechayyavin aleha malkot. uchevar nitbaer bechol mitzva umitzva devarim sheasurim min hattora udevarim sheasurin middivrehem: 
Veod yesh sham reshaim shehen pesulin leedut af al pi shehen bene tashlumin veenan bene malkot. hoil velokchim mamon sheeno shellahem bechamas pesulin shenneemar <small>(Devarim 19 16)</small> "ki yakum ed chamas beish". kegon haggannavim vehachamsanim af al pi shehechzir pasul leedut meet shegganav o gazal. vechen ed zomem af al pi shehuzam beedut mamon veshillem hare ze pasul min hattora lechol edut. umeematay hu nifsal meet sheheid bevet din. af al pi shello huzam al otah edut ella achar kamma yamim. vechen hammalve beribbit echad hammalve veechad hallo shenehem pesulin leedut. im ribbit ketzutza asu hare hen pesulin min hattora veim avak ribbit asu hare hen pesulin middivrehem. vechen kol haover al gezel shel divrehem hare hu pasul middivrehem. ketzad. hachamsanim vehem hallokchim karka o mittaltelin shello birtzon habbealim af al pi shennotnin haddamim hare ellu pesulin middivrehem. vechen haroim echad roe behema dakka veechad roe behema gassa shel atzman hare hen pesulin shechezkatan poshtin yedehen begezel umenichim behemtan lirot besadot ufardesim shel acherim ulefichach setam roe pasul. umegaddele behema dakka beeretz yisrael pesulin aval bechutza laaretz kesherin. umuttar legaddel behema gassa bechol makom. vechen hammochsin setaman pesulin mippene shechezkatan likkach yoter middavar hakkatzuv lahem bedin hammalchut velokchin hetter leatzman. aval gabbae menat hammelech setaman kesherin veim noda shellakchu afillu paam achat yeter min harauy lahem ligbot hare ellu pesulin. vechen mafriche yonim bayyishshuv pesulin mippene shechezkatan sheggozlim yonim shel acherim bechinnam. vechen sochare sheviit vehem bene adam sheyyoshvin betelim vechevan shebbaa sheviit poshtim yedehen umatchilin lissa velitten beferot shechezkat ellu shehen osfin perot sheviit veosin bahen sechora. vechen mesachek bekubbiyya vehu shello tihye lo ummanut ella hu. hoil veeno osek beyishshuvo shel olam hare ze bechezkat sheochel min hakkubbiyya shehu avak gezel. velo bekubbiyya bilvad ella afillu mesachakim biklippe egozim ukelippe rimmonim. vechen lo yonim bilvad amru ella afillu hamesachakim bivhema chayya veof veomer kol hakkodem et chavero o kol hannotzeach et chavero yittol bealav et shenehen. vechen kol kayyotze bischok ze. vehu shello tihye lo ummanut ella sechok ze hare hu pasul. vechol ellu pesulin middivrehem: 
Aris shellakach davar muat min happerot shebbikkeru bime nisan vime tishre kodem shettiggamer melachtan. af al pi shellakach shello middaat baal hassade eno gannav vechasher leedut. sheen baal hassade makpid alav. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 11:
Mi sheeno lo bemikra velo bemishna velo bederech eretz hare ze bechezkat rasha ufasul leedut middivrehem. shekkol mi sheyyarad ad kach chazaka shehu over al rov haaverot sheyyavou leyado: 
Lefichach en mosrin edut leam haaretz veen mekabbelin mimmennu edut ella im ken huchzak shehu osek bemitzvot uvigmilut chasadim venoheg bedarche hayesharim veyesh bo derech eretz mekabbelin eduto af al pi shehu am haaretz veeno lo bemikra velo bemishna: 
Nimtzeta omer kol talmid chacham bechezkat kasher ad sheyyippasel. kol am haaretz bechezkat shehu pasul ad sheyyuchzak shehu holech bedarche hayesharim: 
Vechol mi sheyyekabbel edut am haaretz terem shettihye lo chazaka zo o kodem sheyyavou edim veyaidu shehu noheg bemitzvot uvederech eretz hare ze hedyot veatid litten et haddin shehare meabbed mamonan shel yisrael al pi reshaim: 
Vechen habbezuyin pesulin leedut middivrehem vehem haanashim sheholchin veochlin bashshuk bifne kol haam uchegon ellu sheholchin arumim bashshuk beet shehen oskin bimlacha menuvelet vechayyotze beellu sheen makpidin al habboshet. shekkol ellu chashuvin kechelev veen makpidin al edut sheker. umikkelal ellu haochlin tzedaka shel akkum befarhesya af al pi sheefshar lahen sheyyizzonu betzina mevazzim atzman veenan choshshin. kol ellu pesulin middivrehem: 
Ma ben pasul leedut min hattora lefasul middivrehem. shehappasul min hattora sheheid eduto betela af al pi shello hichrizu alav bevatte kenesiyyot uvevatte midrashot vehappasul middivrehem tzarich hacheraza. lefichach kol edut sheheid kodem shehichrizu alav mekabbelin ota kede shello leabbed zechut haam shehare lo yadu shehu pasul veen pesulo ella middivrehem: 
Ed echad neeman beissurin af al pi shehu pasul lishar eduyot. shehare rasha baavera sheshshachat shechitato keshera veneeman lomar kahalacha shachatti. aval hechashud al davar eno neeman al shello aval neeman hu al acherim: 
Lefichach hechashud al davar yesh lo ladun bo ulehaid bo laacherim. chazaka en adam chote kede sheyyehanu acherim. ketzad. neeman am haaretz lomar perot peloni metukkanim hem. veneeman hannechshad limkor besar bechor lomar basar ze shemmocher peloni chullin hu. vechen kol kayyotze baze mishshear haissurin. lefi sheemat haissurim al harshaim veen emat hammamon alehen: 
Malche yisrael lo meidin velo meidin alehen mippene shehen allamim baale zeroa veenan nichnain tachat ol haddayyanim. aval kohen gadol meidin alav umeid hu lammelech bevet din haggadol kemo shebbearnu: 
Hammosrin vehaeppikorosin vehammumarim lo hitzrichu chachamim limnotan bichlal pesule edut shello manu ella rishe yisrael. aval ellu hammordin hakkofrin pechutin hen min haakkum. shehaakkum lo maalin velo moridin veyesh lachasidehen chelek laolam habba. veellu moridin velo maalin veen lahen chelek laolam habba:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 12:
Kol hannifsal baavera im heidu alav shene edim sheasa avera pelonit af al pi shello hitru bo shehare eno loke hare ze pasul leedut. bamme devarim amurim kesheavar al devarim sheppashat beyisrael shehen avera. kegon shennishba lashsheker o lashshav o gazal o ganav o achal nevela vechayyotze bo. aval im rauhu edim over al davar shekkarov haose lihyot shogeg tzerichin lehazehiro veachar kach yippasel. ketzad. rauhu kosher o mattir beshabbat tzerichin lehodio shezze chillul shabbat mippene sherov haam enan yodin ze. vechen im rauhu ose melacha beshabbat o bayyom tov tzerichin lehodio shehayyom shabbat shemma shocheach hu. vechen hamesachek bekubbiyya tamid o mi shennaasa moches o gabbay shemmosif leatzmo tzerichin haedim lehodio shehaose davar ze pasul leedut. sherov haam enan yodim devarim ellu. vechen kol kayyotze baze. kelalo shel davar kol avera shehaddevarim marim laedim shezze yada shehu rasha veavar bezadon af al pi shello hitru bo hare ze pasul leedut veeno loke: 
En adam nifsal baavera al pi atzmo. ketzad. hare shebba levet din veamar shegganav o gazal o hilva beribbit. af al pi shemmeshallem al pi atzmo eno nifsal. vechen im amar sheachal nevela o baal asura eno nifsal ad sheyyihyu sham shene edim sheen adam mesim et atzmo rasha. lefichach reuven sheheid alav shimon shehilva beribbit veheid levi veamar li hilva beribbit. hare reuven nifsal beedut shimon velevi af al pi shehare hoda levi shellava beribbit eno mesim atzmo rasha veneeman al reuven veeno neeman al atzmo. vechen mi sheheid sheppeloni revao ben beanso shel nirba ben birtzono hu veacher mitztarfin lehargo. peloni ba al ishti hu veacher mitztarfin lehargo aval lo lehargah. vechen kol kayyotze baze. peloni rava et shori hu veacher mitztarfin lehargo sheen adam karov etzel mamono: 
Shenayim sheheidu al echad shehu pasul baavera meellu haaverot uvau shenayim veheidu sheasa teshuva vechazar bo o shellaka hare ze kasher. aval im bau shenayim vehichchishum veamru lo asa avera zo velo nifsal hare ze safek pasul. lefichach lo yaid veen motziin mamon beeduto velo yadun ad sheyyivvada sheasa teshuva: 
Kol mi shennitchayyev malkot ben sheasa teshuva ben shellaka bevet din chozer lechashruto. aval shear pesule edut shehen pesulin mishshum mamon shechamsu o sheggazlu af al pi sheshshillemu tzerichin teshuva vahare hen pesulin ad sheyyivvada shechazru bahen middarkan hara: 
Meematay chazarat malvim beribbit mishsheyyikreu shitrotehen meatzman. veyachzeru bahen chazara gemura shello yalvu beribbit afillu leakkum: 
Meematay chazarat hamesachakin bekubbiyya mishsheyyishberu et pasifsehem. veyachzeru bahen chazara gemura shello yaasu afillu bechinnam: 
Meematay chazarat mafriche yonim mishsheyyishberu et hakkelim shetztzadin bahen. veyachzeru bahen chazara gemura sheafillu bammidbar lo yaasu: 
Meematay chazarat sochare sheviit mishshettaggia sheviit veyibbadku. velo chazarat devarim bilvad ella kotev ani peloni ben peloni kanasti matayim zuz mipperot sheviit vahare hem netunim bemattana laaniyyim: 
Meematay chazarat hammoel bishvua mishsheyyavo levet din sheen makkirin oto veyomar lahem chashud ani o yitchayyev shevua bevet din sheen makkirin oto bemamon chashuv yeshallem velo yirtze lehishshava. vechen tabbach shehaya bodek leatzmo umocher veyatzat terefa mittachat yado shehare hu bichlal ochle terefa shehen pesulin leedut. hare ze pasul leedut ad sheyyerae mimmaasav shennicham al raato. veyilbash shechorim vichasse shechorim veyelech lemakom sheen makkirin oto veyachzir aveda bemamon chashuv. o yotzi terefa mittachat yado bedavar chashuv: 
Vechen ed zomem shehalach lemakom sheen makkirin oto venatnu lo mamon chashuv lehaid besheker velo ratza hare ze asa teshuva vechazar lechashruto. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 13:
Hakkerovim pesulim leedut min hattora shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 16)</small> "lo yumetu avot al banim". mippi hashshemua lamdu shebbichlal lav ze shello yumetu avot al pi banim velo banim al pi avot. vehu haddin lishar kerovim. en pesulin middin tora ella kerovim mimmishpachat av bilvad. vehem haav im habben veim ben habben. vehaachin min haav ze im ze uvenehen ze im ze veen tzarich lomar haddodim im ben achiv. aval shear hakkerovim min haem o midderech haishut kullan pesulin middivrehem: 
Haggerim enan bedin hakkerovim. afillu shene achim teomim shennitgayyeru meidin ze laze. shehagger shennitgayyer kekatan shennolad hu chashuv: 
Haachim ze im ze ben min haem ben min haav hare hen rishon berishon. uvenehem ze im ze sheni besheni. uvene benehem ze im ze shelishi bishlishi: 
Uleolam shelishi berishon kasher veen tzarich lomar shelishi besheni. aval sheni besheni veen tzarich lomar sheni berishon shenehem pesulim: 
Haav im beno kerishon berishon hu. lefichach haav im ben beno pasul. veim ben ben beno shehu revii mimmennu kasher mippene shehu shelishi berishon. vechen hadderech binkevot. ketzad. shete achayot o ach vaachoto ben min haav ben min haem hare hem rishon berishon. benehem ben zecharim ben nekevot sheni besheni. bene benehem o benot benotehen shelishi bishlishi. kederech sheatta mone bizcharim rishon sheni ushelishi kach atta mone binkevot: 
Kol ishsha sheatta pasul lah kach atta pasul levalah shehabbaal keishto. vechol baal sheatta pasul lo kach atta pasul leishto shehaishsha kevalah: 
Kol shete nashim shehen zo im zo sheni besheni balehen meidin ze laze. aval im haya rishon berishon kegon shellakach ze ishsha veze bittah en meidin ze laze: 
Vechen bale achayot pesulin ze laze vahare hen rishon berishon: 
Vechen lo yaid leven achot ishto velo levaal bat achot ishto. aval meid hu leven baal achot ishto sheyyesh lo meishsha acheret: 
Kol ish sheen atta meid lo mippene shehu baal kerovatcha hare atta meid lishar kerovav kegon beno veachiv. vechen kol ishsha sheen atta meid lah mippene shehi eshet kerovcha hare atta meid lishar keroveha: 
Avi kalla vaavi chatan meidim ze laze: 
Ache haach min haem meidin ze laze shehare en benehen kurva kelal. ketzad. rachel shennisset leyosef veyalda mimmenna reuven. vehaya leyosef ben meishsha acheret vehu menashshe. umet yosef venisset leshimon veyalda mimmennu yehuda. hare menashshe vihuda meidin ze laze: 
Haish im ishto rishon berishon. lefichach eno meid lo livnah. velo leeshet benah. velo levittah. velo levaal bittah. velo leaviha. velo leimmah. velo levaal immah. velo leeshet aviha: 
Ishto arusa af al pi shello nigmera haishut hare hi kinsua leinyan edut. [bamme devarim amurim] baarusato atzmah sheeno meid lah. aval im heid likrove arusato kegon baal achotah o benah uvittah vechayyotze bahen en poslin otah ad sheyyissaenna: 
Ze sheppasla tora edut hakkerovim lo mippene shehen bechezkat ohavin ze et ze. shehare eno meid lo lo letovato velo leraato. ella gezerat hakkatuv hu. lefichach haohev vehassone kasher leedut af al pi shehu pasul ledayyanut. shello gazra tora ella al hakkerovim:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 14: Kol mi sheen atta meoyd lo mippene shehu baal kerovatcha. im meta ishto af al pi shehinnicha lo banim hare ze nitrachek vechasher:

Mi shehaya yodea lachavero edut ad shello naasa chatano venaasa chatano. o sheyyada haedut vehu pikkeach veachar kach nitcharesh. patuach venistamme af al pi sheyyachol lechavven middat hakkarka shehu meid bah umesayyem metzareha. shafuy venishtatta. hare ze pasul. aval im haya yodea lo edut ad shello naasa chatano venaasa chatano umeta bitto. pikkeach venitcharesh vechazar venitpakkeach shafuy venishtatta vechazar venishtappa patuach venistamme vechazar venitpatteach kasher. ze hakkelal kol shettechillato vesofo bechashrut af al pi shennifsal bentayim kasher. techillato befaslut af al pi shessofo bechashrut pasul. lefichach mi shehaya yodea beedut vehu katan uva veheid bah keshehu gadol enah kelum:

Veyesh devarim shessomchin bahen al edut shemmeid keshehu gadol hoil vehem devarim shel divrehem. veellu hen haddevarim sheadam neeman lehaid begadlo al ma sheraa bekatno. neeman adam lomar ze ketav yado shel avi o shel rabbi o shel achi mippene shekkiyyum shetarot middivrehem. zachur ani biflonit shennisset venaasa lah minhag habbetulot. hoil verov nashim betulot nissaot uchetubba middivrehem. shehammakom hazze bet happeras mippene shettumato middivrehem. vead kan hayinu bain beshabbat shetztzimtzum hattechum ad alpayim amma bilvad middivrehem. shehaya ish peloni yotze mibbet hassefer litbol veleechol bitrumato laerev. veshehaya cholek immanu teruma. veshehayinu molichim challa umattanot lifloni kohen al yede atzmo. veamar li abba mishpacha zo keshera mishpacha zo pesula. veachalnu bakotzatza shel peloni sheheechiluni echav kede lehodia sheachihem peloni nasa ishsha sheenah hogenet lo. shekkol ellu haddevarim lehachazik ze hakkohen leechol bitruma shel divrehem o lidchoto mimmenna:
Kol ellu shemmeid bahen haggadol bema sheyyada keshehaya katan. im haya akkum o eved kesheraa devarim ellu veheid achar shennitgayyer venishtachrer eno neeman:

Mi shehaya yodea lachavero beedut ad shello naasa gazlan venaasa gazlan. hu eno meid al ketav yado. aval im huchzak ketav yado shebbishtar ze bevet din kodem sheyyease gazlan hare ze shetar kasher. vechen im naasa chatano hu eno meid al ketav yado aval acherim meidin. af al pi shello huchzak bevet din ella achar shennaasa chatano hare ze kasher. sheeno dome happasul baavera lefasul bikriva. shehappasul baavera chashud lezayyef:

Shetar sheyyesh bo shene edim bilvad ushenehem kerovim ze laze o echad mishshenehem pasul baavera. af al pi shemmasar lo hashshetar bifne edim kesherim hare hu kecheres mippene shehu mezuyyaf mittocho:

Hakkotev kol nechasav lishne bene adam beedut achat vehaedim kerovim leechad mimmekabbele hammattana urechokim min hashsheni. hare hashshetar pasul mippene shehu edut achat. aval im katav bishtar echad shennatatti liruven chatzer pelonit veshennatatti leshimon sade pelonit. nimtzeu haedim kerovim laze urechokim mizze. ze shehem rechokim mimmennu mattenato kayyemet sheellu shete eduyot af al pi shehen bishtar echad. lema ze dome leomer heyu alay edim shennatatti liruven kach vechach veshennatatti leshimon kach vechach veshellaviti millevi kach vechach sheaf al pi shekkatav bishtar echad vehammakne ish echad hare ellu shalosh eduyyot sheenan teluyot zo bazo:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 15:
Kol edut shettavo hanaa leadam mimmenna eno meid bah shezze hu kemeid al atzmo. lefichach bene hair shebba mearer learer alehem bammerchatz o birchov shel ir. en echad mibbaale hair meid bedavar ze velo dan ad sheyyesallek atzmo bekinyan gamur veachar kach yaid o yadin: 
Bene hair shennignav sefer tora shellahen hoil velishmia hu asuy shei efshar leadam lesallek atzmo mimmennu en danin bedayyane otah hair veen meviin reaya meanshe otah hair. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Haomer tenu mane laaniyye iri en danin bedayyane otah hair veen meviin reaya meanshe otah hair. bamme devarim amurim keshehayu haaniyyim semuchim alehem ufoskin alehen tzedaka. afillu amru shenayim meanshe otah hair anu nitten davar hakkatzuv alenu venaid en shomin lahem. shehanaa hu lahem sheyyitashsheru aniyyim ellu hoil vehen semuchin al bene hair. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Karka shebben shene shuttafin shebba mearer lehotziah mittachat yad hashuttaf. eno meid leshuttafo aleha ella im sillek atzmo mimmenna vekanu miyyado shennetanah lashshuttaf vesheim ba baal chov shello uterafah miyyad hashuttaf meshallem lo dameha. veachar kach meid lo aleha. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Haorer al hassade im yesh bah perot en haaris meid lo aleha. shehare rotze haaris lehaamidah beyad bealeha kede sheyyittol chelko bapperot. veim en bah perot meid. aval hassocher im lakach hassechirut beyado veamar kol mi shettitkayyem sade zo beyado yittol hare ze meid. veim kevar natan hassechirut levaal hassade eno meid. kevan sheim tetze hassade lamarer chayyav litten lo sechar kol hashshanim sheyyashav bah eno meid. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Shimon shellava vehaya reuven arev uva yehuda learer al shimon hallo vehotzi karka mittachat yado. im yesh leshimon sade acheret keneged hachov hare reuven hearev yesh lo lehaid al oto karka shehi shel shimon. sheen lo hanaa baze sheim lekachah yehuda hare sade acheret sheyyippara mimmenna baal chovo. vechen lokeach rishon meid lelokeach sheni shellakach acharav shezze hassade shello. vehu sheyyesh lammocher sade ben chorin keneged deme sade shel lokeach rishon. sheen lelokeach rishon hanaa baamidat ze hassade beyad lokeach sheni. sheafillu nitraf lokeach harishon al hammocher hu chozer vahare yesh lo sade acheret sheyyigbe mimmenna:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 16: Reuven sheggazal sade o tallit mishshimon uva yehuda veirer al reuven veamar sade zo o tallit zo shelli hi. en shimon yachol lehaid liruven sheen zo hassade shel yehuda velo zo hattallit shel yehuda. shehare shimon rotze lehaamid sade zo o tallit zo beyad reuven shehu gezalah mimmennu kede sheyyachzeru lo miyyad haggazlan. shehare efshar shettihye haraya shel shimon shemmotzi bah miyyad reuven efshar sheeno yachol lehotzi bah miyyad yehuda. vechen im machar reuven hassade haggezula o horishah lelevi uva yehuda learer al levi. en shimon meid sheenah shel yehuda shemma nachat ruach yesh lo lehotziah miyyad levi:

Machar hattallit haggezula lelevi uva yehuda learer. im met reuven shimon meid aleha sheenah shel yehuda shehare en tallit zo chozeret leshimon leolam shekkevar kenaah hallokeach beyeush veshinnuy reshut uchevar met reuven haggazlan veen lo mimmi yittol dameha. aval im adayin reuven kayyam en shimon meid af al hattallit. shehanaa hi lo shello taamod beyad yehuda kede sheyyavi reaya sheruven gezalah vishallem dameha. vechen im hayta hattallit beyad yorshe reuven en shimon meid aleha mippene shessofah sheim taamod beyad hayyoresh lachzor lo. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Reuven shemmachar sade leshimon shello beacharayut uva yehuda learer al shimon ulehotziah mittachat yado. en reuven meid lo aleha. af al pi sheen aleha acharayut hare hu rotze shettaamod beyad shimon kede sheyyavo baal chov shel reuven veyitrefenna bechovo velo yihye lo rasha velo yeshallem:

Reuven shemmachar para o tallit leshimon uva yehuda learer ulehotzi miyyad shimon. reuven meid lo aleha shehi shel shimon sheafillu amda beyad shimon en baal chovo shel reuven toref min hammittaltelin vaafillu hayu appoteke. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya shimon mode shezzo happara vehattallit hem shel reuven hammocher bevadday vehu yodea shebbeemet hen shello. aval im lo hoda shimon en reuven meid leabbed zechut yehuda. sheim tetze mittachat yede shimon yachzor shimon veyitba damim veyomar lo macharta li davar sheeno shellecha shehare bau edim veamru shehen shel yehuda. bamme devarim amurim sheyyaid reuven leabbed zechut yehuda veyaamid hammittaltelin beyad shimon keshebbau edim veheidu shehem yodim sheruven ze lo hayta lo karka meolam. aval im lo bau edim lechach af al happara vehattallit eno meid. velamma eno meid alehen. shemma hikna otam levaal chovo aggav karka vechatav deikne vehikna lo mittaltelin aggav karka shennimtza baal chovo toref af happara vehattallit. lefichach lo yaid alehen shehare rotze lehaamidan beyad shimon kede sheyyavo baal chovo veyitrefem. vechen kol kayyotze bidvarim ellu. udevarim ellu enan teluyin ella bedaat haddayyan veotzem binato sheyyavin ikkar hammishpatim veyeda davar haggorem ledavar acher veyaamik lirot. im yimmatze sheyyesh leze haed tzad hanaa beedut zo afillu bederech rechoka veniflaa hare ze lo yaid bah. uchederech shello yaid bedavar ze shemma nogea beeduto hu kach lo yadun beoto davar. vechen shear mine pesulin keshem shepposlin beedim kach poslin bedayyanim:

Ulefichach en somchin besanhedrin shenayim hakkerovim ze laze ben besanhedri ketanna ben besanhedri gedola. aval ellu shemmosifin ad shiva leabber hashshana kemo shebbearnu behilchot kiddush hachodesh yerae li sheim haya bahen kerovim en bechach kelum:

Kol hakkasher ladun kasher lehaid. veyesh kasher lehaid veeno kasher ladun. haohev. vehassone. vehagger. vehameshuchrar. vechen hazzaken. vehassaris. vehammamzer. vesuma beachat meenav. kesherin lehaid veenan kesherim ladun dine nefashot kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 17: Mi sheheidu lo anashim rabbim ugedolim bechachma uveyira shehem omrim sherau peloni sheavar avera pelonit. o shellava mippeloni. af al pi shehu maamin haddavar belibbo keillu raahu lo yaid ad sheyyire haddavar beenav o yode lo hallo mippiv veyomar lo heye alay ed sheppeloni hilva li mane. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 1)</small> "vehu ed o raa o yada". veen lecha edut shemmitkayyemet biriyya o bidia ella edut mamon. vechol hammeid mippi acherim hare ze ed sheker veover belo taase shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 13)</small> "lo taane vereacha ed shaker":

Lefichach meayyemin af al ede hammamon. vechetzad meayyemin alehen. [meayyemin alehem] bifne hakkol. umodiin otan koach edut sheker uvoshet hammeid bah baolam hazze uvaolam habba. veachar kach motziin et kol haadam lachutz umeshayyerin et haggadol shebbaedim veomer lo emor heach atta yodea shezze chayyav laze. im amar shehu amar li chayyav ani lo o ish peloni amar li shehu chayyav lo lo amar kelum ad sheyyomar befanenu hoda lo shehu chayyav lo. vehayu machnisin et haed hashsheni uvodkin oto kach. nimtzeu divrehen mechuvvanin nosin venotnin baddavar vegomrin haddin:

Hammatmin edim lachavero vehoda lo beno leven atzmo vehaedim roin veshomin shehu omer lo vadday yesh lecha etzli kach vechach aval mityare ani shemma techufeni bedin lemachar hare zo enah edut ad sheyyode bifne edim:

Echad hammode bifne edim. veamar derech hodaa ze yesh lo etzli kach vechach. o sheamar attem eday o sheamar heyu alay edim. ben sheamar hallo ben sheamar hammalve veshatak hallo derech maamin lidvarav. hare ellu edim. veen tzarich lomar im kanu miyyado o sheamar lahem kitvu alay shetar sheyyesh laze etzli kach vechach vechol kayyotze bidvarim ellu hare hem hodaa umeidin al piv:
Talmid sheamar lo rabbo yodea atta sheim notnin li kol mamon haolam eni meshakker mane yesh li etzel peloni veyesh li alav ed echad lech vehitztaref immo. im nitztaref hare ze ed sheker:

Amar lo bo vaamod im haed velo taid kede sheyyire hallo vifached veyaale al dato sheattem shene edim veyode meatzmo hare ze asur laamod uleharot shehu ed af al pi sheeno meid. veal ze vechayyotze bo neemar <small>(Shemot 23 7)</small> "middevar sheker tirchak":
Hassocher ede sheker lehaid lachavero patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim. vechen ed echad shekkavash eduto velo heid patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 18:
Mi sheheid besheker venoda beedim sheheid besheker zehu shennikra ed zomem. umitzvat ase laasot lo kema sheratza laasot beeduto lachavero. im baavera shechayyavin aleha sekila heidu vehuzemu niskalin kullan. veim bisrefa nisrafin vechen shear hammitot. veim heidu bemalkot loke kol echad mehen kishar mechuyyeve malkot. veomdin kocho umalkin oto. veim heidu lechayyevo mamon meshalleshin hammamon benehen lefi minyan haedim. kol echad veechad yitten chelek hammaggia lo. veen lokin bimkom tashlumin: 
Bamme devarim amurim beedim shehuzemu. aval shete kittot hammachchishot zo et zo veen kan edut en onshin et achat mehen. lefi sheen anu yodim mi hi hakkat hashshakranit. uma ben hachechasha lahazama. hahachchasha baedut atzmah zot omeret haya haddavar hazze vezot omeret lo haya haddavar hazze o yavo mikkelal devareha shello haya. vehahazama baedim atzman veellu haedim shehezimum enan yodim im nihya haddavar o lo haya. ketzad. edim shebbau veamru rainu ze sheharag et hannefesh o lava mane mippeloni beyom peloni bemakom peloni. veachar sheheidu venivdeku bau shenayim acherim veamru beyom ze uvemakom ze hayinu immachem veim ellu kol hayyom. velo hayu devarim meolam lo ze harag et ze velo ze hilva et ze hare zo hachechasha. vechen im amru lahem heach attem meidim kach veze hahoreg o hanneherag o hallo o hammalve haya immanu beyom ze bimdina acheret. hare zo edut muchcheshet shezze kemi sheamar lo harag ze et ze velo ze hilva et ze shehare immanu hayu velo nihya davar ze. vechen kol kayyotze bidvarim ellu. aval im amru lahem anu en anu yodim im ze harag ze beyom ze birushalayim kemo sheattem omrin o lo harago. veanu meidim sheattem atzmechem heyitem immanu beyom ze bevavel. hare ellu zommim veneheragin o meshallemin. hoil vehaedim shehezimum lo hishgichu al atzmah shel edut kelal im emet haya o sheker: 
Veze sheheemina tora edut haacharonim al haedim harishonim gezerat hakkatuv hi. afillu hayu haedim harishonim mea uvau shenayim vehezimum veamru lahem anu meidim sheattem hammea kullechem immanu heyitem beyom peloni bemakom peloni hare ellu neenashin al pihem. shehashshenayim kemea umea kishnayim. vechen bishte kitte edim hammachchishot zo et zo en holchin achar harov ella dochin et shetehen: 
Edim zommin enan tzerichin hateraa. veedim shehuchchashu ulevassof huzammu hare ellu neheragin o lokin o meshallemin mippene shehachechasha techillat hazama hi ella sheadayin lo nigmera: 
En mezimin et haedim ella bifnehem. umachchishin et haedim shello bifnehem. veedim shehuzammu shello bifnehen hare huchchashu. lefichach im metu haedim shehezimum kodem sheyyazimu otam bifnehem en kan edut shehare hichchishu ze et ze: 
Ede nefashot shehuchchashu velo huzammu afillu ba hanneherag beraglav enam lokin. mippene shehu lav shennittan leazharat mitat bet din veen lokin alav. aval bet din makkin otan makkat mardut kefi ma sheyyiru: 
Edim zommim tzerichin hacheraza. veheach hi hahachraza shellahen. kotvin vesholchin bechol ir veir peloni ufeloni heidu bechach vechach vehuzammu vaharagnum. o laku befanenu o anashnu otan kach vechach dinarin. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 19 20)</small> "vehannisharim yishmeu veyirau": 
Chiyyuv haedim zommim leshallem bemakom shechayyavin leshallem kenas hu ulefichach en meshallemin al pi atzman. ketzad. hare sheheidu venechkera edutan bevet din veachar kach amru shenehem edut sheker headnu veen laze etzel ze kelum. o sheamarnu headnu al ze bechach vechach vehuzamnu en meshallemin al pihen. aval im amru headnu al ze vehuzamnu bevet dino shel peloni venitchayyavnu litten lo kach vechach hare ellu meshallemin shezzo hodaa bemamon shennigmar dino litteno. veim amar haechad kach meshallem chelko:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 19:
Shennayim sheheidu veamru bemizrach habbira harag ze et hannefesh beshaa pelonit uvau shenayim veamru lahen bemaarav habbira hazzot heyitem immanu baet hazzot. im yachol haomed bemaarav lirot ma shebbammizrach enan zommin. veim eno yachol lirot hare ellu zommin veen omrin shemma meor enehem shel rishonim rav veroin merachok yeter mikkol adam. vechen im heidu shenayim veamru babboker harag ze et hannefesh birushalayim uvau shenayim veamru lahen beyom ze baerev heyitem immanu belud. im yachol adam lehallech afillu al hassus mirushalayim lelud mibboker ad erev enan zommin veim lav hare ellu zommin veen omrin shemma kar kal beyoter nizdammen lahen vekippelu et hadderech ella bedavar hammatzuy hayyadua lakkol meshaarin leolam umezimin otan: 
Shenayim sheamru beechad beshabbat harag ze et hannefesh bemakom peloni uvau shenayim veamru beyom ze immanu heyitem bemakom acher rachok aval bayyom shelleachar yom ze harago bevadday afillu heidu haacharonim shekkodem kamma yamim harago hare ze hahoreg im edav harishonim neheragin shehare huzemu. shebbeet sheheidu sheharag adayin lo nigmar dino lehareg. aval bau shene edim bishlishi beshabbat veamru beechad beshabbat nigmar dino shel peloni lahariga uvau shenayim veamru beechad beshabbat immanu heyitem bemakom peloni harachok ella meerev shabbat o besheni beshabbat nigmar dino. en edim ellu shehuzammu neheragin shehare mikkol makom beet sheheidu alav kevar nigmar dino lahariga. vechen leinyan tashlume kenas. ketzad. bau shenayim bishlishi beshabbat veamru beechad beshabbat ganav vetavach venigmar dino uvau shenayim veamru beechad beshabbat immanu heyitem bemakom rachok aval beerev shabbat nigmar dino. afillu amru [beechad] beshabbat ganav vetavach umachar uvesheni beshabbat nigmar dino en edim ellu shehuzammu meshallemin shehare mikkol makom beet sheheidu alav chayyav haya leshallem. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
En ede hashshetar naasin zommin ad sheyyomru bevet din shetar ze bizmanno ketavnuhu velo icharnuhu. aval im lo amru ken af al pi shezzemanno shel shetar beechad benisan birushalayim uvau edim veheidu sheede hashshetar hayu immahem bevavel beyom ze. hashshetar kasher vehaedim kesherim sheefshar shekketavuhu veicharuhu ucheshehayu birushalayim beechad baadar katvu shetar ze sham veicharu zemanno vechatvu zemanno benisan. amru bizmanno ketavnuhu vehuzammu im yesh sham edim sheyyodim hayyom shechatmu al hashshetar o edim sherau ze hashshetar vachatimat yadam bo beyom peloni. kevan shehuzammu hare nifselu lemafrea miyyom shennoda shechatmu al hashshetar. shehaedim hachatumim al hashshetar hare hen kemi shennechkera edutan bevet din beet hachatima. aval im en edim sherau edutan velo rau hashshetar mikkodem en nifsalin ella meet sheheidu bevet din shezze ketav yadan veamru bizmanno ketavnuhu veefshar shebbeyom ze sheheidu bevet din bo bayyom chatmu al hashshetar sheyyesh lo kamma shanim vehem shikkeru veamru bizmanno katavnu:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 20: En edim zommin neheragin velo lokin velo meshallemin ad sheyyihyu shenehem reuyin leedut veyizzomu shenehem achar shennigmar haddin. aval im huzam echad mehen bilvad o shehuzammu shenehem kodem gemar din o achar gemar din venimtza echad mehen karov o pasul en neenashin af al pi shehuzammu venifselu lechol edut shebbattora:

Neherag ze sheheidu alav veachar kach huzammu enan neheragin min haddin. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 19 19)</small> "kaasher zamam laasot" vaadayin lo asa. vedavar ze mippi hakkabbala. aval im laka ze sheheidu alav lokin. vechen im yatza hammamon miyyad ze leyad ze beedutan chozer livalav umeshallemin lo:

Hayu haedim shelosha afillu mea im heidu bevet din ze achar ze veheid kol echad mehen achar chavero betoch kede dibbur vehuzammu miktzatan en neenashin ad sheyyuzammu kullan. aval im haya hefsek ben ze laze yeter mikkede dibbur shehu kede sheelat shalom talmid lerav. hare nechleka haedut vehashshenayim shehuzammu neenashin vehashshenayim haacherim shehaya ben divrehen vedivre harishonim hefsek en neenashin. veaf al pi shebbatla haedut kullah. mippene shehen kat achat hoil venifsela mikketzatah nifsela kullah:

Heid haechad venechkera eduto veamar hashsheni af ani kamohu o sheamar hen kayyotze baze vehuzammu shenehen hare shenehen neheragin o lokin o meshallemin. shekkol ed sheamar achar edut chavero hen hare ze kemi shennechkar veheid kemo sheheid chavero. veen leedim zommin shegaga lefi sheen bah maase. lefichach en tzerichim hateraa kemo shebbearnu:

Keshem shehashshenayim mezimin et hammea im heidu hammea bevat achat. kach hen mezimin otan afillu hayu chamishshim kat uvau shenayim achar shenayim. ketzad. kat sheheida al reuven sheharag et shimon birushalayim uvau shene edim vehezimuha. uvat kat sheniyya veheida otah edut atzmah sheruven harag shimon birushalayim veamdu otan hashshenayim vehezimuha gam zo hakkat hashsheniyya vechen hashshelishit vechen harviit afillu mea kullan hen neheragin al pi ellu hashshenayim:

Kat sheheida al reuven sheharag et shimon birushalayim uvaa kat sheniyya vehezima et hakkat rishona yehargu haedim hazzommin veyinnatzel reuven. baa kat shelishit vehezima et hakkat hashsheniyya tehareg hakkat hashsheniyya ureuven vetinnatzel hakkat rishona. baa kat reviit vehezima et hakkat shelishit tehareg hakkat hashshelishit veharishona veyinnatzel reuven vehakkat hashsheniyya. vechen afillu hen mea kat zo mezimma et zo kat nichneset vechat yotzet:

Edim sheheidu al ish terefa sheharag vehuzammu en neheragin. sheafillu haraguhu bidehen en neheragin lefi shehu terefa. vechen haedim shehayu terefa veheidu bedavar shechayyavin alav mitat bet din vehuzammu en neheragin. sheim yuzammu zommehen en zommehen neheragin shello hezimu ella terefa:

Edim sheheidu al echad vehirshiuhu resha sheen bo lo malkot velo mita velo chiyyuv mamon veachar kach huzammu. hare ellu lokin af al pi shello zammu lehalekot ze velo lechayyevo mamon. ketzad. heidu al kohen shehu chalal kegon sheheidu befanenu nitgarsha immo o nechletza bemakom peloni beyom peloni vehuzammu hare hen lokin. vechen im heidu al adam sheharag bishgaga vehuzammu lokin veenan golin. heidu al shoro shel ze sheharag hannefesh vehuzammu. hare hen lokin veen meshallemin et hakkofer. heidu alav shennimkar beeved ivri vehuzammu lokin. vearbaa devarim ellu mippi hakkabbala hen:

Kach kibbelu chachamim sheshshenayim shehirshiu et hatztzaddik vehitzdiku et harasha beedutan. uvau edim acherim vehezimum vehitzdiku et hatztzaddik vehirshiu et harasha. hare edim harishonim lokim af al pi shello hirshiu hatztzaddik lehalekoto. aval im heidu alav sheachal basar bechalav o shellavash shaatnez hare ellu lokin. mishshum shenneemar <small>(Devarim 19 19)</small> "vaasitem lo kaasher zamam":
Shenayim sheheidu al reuven shennaaf im bat kohen venigmar din reuven lechanek vedin hannoefet lisrefa veachar kach nimtzeu zommin hare ellu nechnakin velo nisrafin. vedavar ze mippi hakkabbala:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 21:
Edim sheheidu sheppeloni geresh ishto velo natan lah ketubba vehuzammu. vahalo ben hayyom ben lemachar im geresh sofo litten ketubba. omdin kamma rotze adam litten bichtubbatah shel zo shettimkor otah betovat hanaa umeshallemin deme tovat hanaa zo. umeshaarin beishsha uvichtubbatah. sheim haishsha hayta chola o zekena o shehaya shalom benah leven balah en deme hakketubba keshettimmacher kemo dameha im hayta haishsha beria uketanna im yesh benehen ketata shezzo kerova min haggerushin urechoka min hammita. vechen en tovat hanaa shel ketubba hamerubba lefi tovat hanaa shel ketubba hammuetet. sheim hayta ketubbatah elef zuz hare hi nimkeret betovat hanaa bemea. veim hayta mea enah nimkeret baasara ella befachot. devarim ellu kefi ma sheyyeshaaru haddayyanim: 
Heidu al ze shechayyav lifloni elef zuz al menat litten mikkan vead sheloshim yom. vehallo omer ad chamesh shanim achar hashsheloshim yom. venimtzeu zommin. omdin kamma rotze adam litten veyihyu beyado elef zuz chamesh shanim umeshallemin ken lallo. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Heidu al shoro shel ze shennagach venimtzeu zommin meshallemin chatzi nezek. veim en hashshor shave chatzi nezek meshallemin deme hashshor bilvad sheen meshallem chatzi nezek ella miggufo. lefichach im heidu alav sheachal perot o shavar kelim bederech hillucho meshallemin nezek shalem. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Heidu al peloni shehippil shen avdo veachar kach simme et eno vehuzammu. meshallemin laadon deme haeved udeme eno. heidu shessimme et eno veachar kach hippil et shinno vehuzammu (veachar kach) venimtza haddavar hefech shehaadon hippil et shinno veachar kach simme et eno meshallemin deme ayin laeved. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Ede kinnuy usetira shehuzammu lokin. ba ed echad veheid shezzinneta achar kinnuy usetira [venimtza oto haed zomem meshallem ketubbatah. hayu shenayim vehen ede hakkinnuy vehassetira vehattuma] venimtzeu zommin meshallemin keneged hakketubba veen lokin. velamma lo yehargu vahare heidu battuma. lefi shello hitru bah: 
Shenayim sheheidu al ze shegganav vetavach o machar vehuzammu meshallemin et hakkol. heidu shenayim shegganav veheidu shenayim acherim shettavach o machar vehuzammu ellu veellu. hare harishonim meshallemin tashlume kefel veacharonim meshallemin shenayim ushelosha. huzammu haacharonim bilvad hare haggannav meshallem tashlume kefel vehaedim haacharonim meshallemin laggannav tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. nimtza echad min haacharonim zomem batla edut sheniyya. nimtza echad min harishonim zomem batla kol haedut sheim en geneva en hattevicha o hammechira mechayyavto leshallem kelum: 
Shenayim sheheidu sheachal sade zo shalosh shanim venimtzeu zommin meshallemin levaal hassade deme hassade. heidu shenayim sheachalah shana rishona ushenayim sheachalah shana sheniyya ushenayim sheachalah shana shelishit vehuzammu kullan meshalleshin benehen. sheaf al pi sheedut hachazaka shalosh eduyyot hen hare hen keedut achat lahazama. lefichach shelosha achim veechad mitztaref im kol echad veechad veheidu beshana shana hare ellu shalosh eduyyot vetitkayyem bahen hachazaka vehen keedut achat lahazama. sheim huzammu kullan hare shelosha haachin meshallemin chatzi deme hassade veze shennitztaref im kol echad mehen meshallem chatzi dameha: 
Shalosh kitte edim shennitkayyem beedutan sheshshor ze muad venimtzet kat rishona usheniyya zommin kullan peturin. nimtzeu shelashtan zommin kullan chayyavin leshallem hannezek sheaf al pi shehu tam meshallem chatzi nezek. bamme devarim amurim keshehayu kullan romzin ze et ze. o shebbau retzufin. o shehayu makkirin baal hashshor velo hikkiru hashshor. aval im en sham achat meellu hare kat rishona usheniyya peturin shehare hen omrin lo banu ella lechayyevo chatzi nezek velo yadanu shettavo kat acheret veyease muad: 
Vechen shenayim sheheidu beven sorer umore edut harishona uvau shenayim acharehem veheidu alav edut haacharona shebbah yehareg vehuzammu shetehen. kat harishona loka veenah nehereget mippene sheyyecholim lomar lehalekoto banu. aval kat haacharona nehereget sheal pihen bilvad hu neherag. hayta hakkat haacharona arbaa shenayim omrim befanenu ganav ushenayim omrim befanenu achal vehuzammu kullan neheragin. heidu shenayim shezze ganav nefesh miyyisrael umecharo vehuzammu hare ellu nechnakin. heidu shenayim sheggenavo veheidu shenayim acherim shemmecharo. ben shehuzammu ede geneva ben shehuzammu ede mechira kol kat mehen shehuzamma nehereget. shehaggeneva hi techillat chiyyuvo shel ze lemita. heidu shenayim shemmecharo leze hayyisrael vehuzammu velo hayu sham edim sheggenavo hare ellu peturin. sheafillu lo huzammu lo haya ze neherag mippene sheyyachol lomar avdi macharti. bau ede geneva achar shehuzammu ede mechira afillu rainu otan romzin ze et ze en neheragin: 
Motzi shem ra al ishto shehevi edim shezzinneta keshehi arusa vehevi aviha edim vehezimum hare ede habbaal neheragin. chazar habbaal vehevi edim vehezimu ede haav. hare ede haav neheragin umeshallemin mamon labbaal. neheragin mippene sheede habbaal nigmar dinam lahariga beedutan umeshallemin kenas mippene shennigmar din habbaal leshallem kenas beedutan venimtzeu chayyavin nefashot laze umamon laze. vechen shenayim sheheidu al ze shebba al naara hameorasa vehuzemu neheragin veen meshallemin. ba al bitto shel peloni vehuzammu neheragin umeshallemin hakkenas leaviha. peloni rava hashshor vehuzammu niskalin veen meshallemin. shoro shel peloni niskalin umeshallemin deme hashshor levaal hashshor. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 22:
Shete kitte edim hammachchishot zo et zo shebba ed echad mikkat zo veed echad mikkat zo veheidu beedut acheret en kan edut. shehare bevadday echad mehen sheker veen yadua mi hu mishshenehen. baa kat zo bifne atzmah veheida edut uvaa kat zo veheida edut acheret bifne atzmah mekabbelin kol achat mehen bifne atzmah: 
Reuven shehotzi al shimon shene shetarot echad bemane veechad bematayim vechafar shimon bishne hashshetarot veede shetar ze kat achat meotan hashshenayim shehichchishu zo et zo. veede hashshetar hashsheni hakkat hashsheniyya. hare shimon meshallem mane sheyyad baal hashshetar al hattachtona veyishshava al hashshear. yerae li sheshshevua zo sheyyishshava al hashshear binkitat chefetz kedin mode bemiktzat. shehare alav shene edim kesherim meidin bemiktzat hammamon shekkafar bechullo. velo tehe hodaat piv gedola mehaadaat edim kemo shebbearnu: 
Hotzi reuven shetar al levi veedav kat achat mishshetehen. vehotzi shimon shetar sheni al levi veedav hakkat hashsheniyya. velevi kofer bishnehen. hare reuven nishba venotel veshimon nishba venotel shebbevadday echad mehen yesh lo etzlo. ushevua zo betakkanat chachamim kedin chenvani al pinkaso: 
Hotzi reuven shetar al shimon veedav kat achat mehen vehotzi shetar sheni al levi veedav hakkat hashsheniyya vechol echad mehen kofer bo hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. hoil veen reuven yachol lekayyem echad mishshene shetarot hare kol shetar mehen kecheres ushene hannitanin nishbain hesset veniftarin. bamme devarim amurim keshebbau shete hakkittot lehaid keachat. aval kol hammotzi shetar sheyyesh bo edut kat achat mishshetehen hare ze gove bo. veim hotzi achar kach ben hu ben acher shetar sheyyesh bo edut hakkat hashsheniyya hare ze gove bo ben mimmalve harishon ben meacher. shehare kol kat mishshetehen baa bifne atzmah veheida: 
Mi shehevi edim venechkera edutan vehuzammu vechazar vehevi edim acherim beotah hattaana atzmah vehuzammu afillu mea kat. veachar kach hevi edim acherim beotah hattaana atzmah venimtzet edut ellu haacharonim mechuvvenet. danin al pihen. sheaf al pi shehuchzak ze shettaan taana zo lehavi edim shakranim hare lo huchzeku ellu haedim haacharonim shehen meshakkerin. aval shetar shekkara alav arar vehu sheyyavou shenayim veyomru mimmennu shaal lezayyef lo shetar ze af al pi shennitkayyem hashshetar mechotmav en govin bo leolam. veyerae li sheim bau ede hashshetar veheidu hen beatzman al ketav yadan govin bo: seliku lehu hilchot edut besad
Mishneh Torah, Rebels 1:
Bet din haggadol shebbirushalayim hem ikkar tora shebbeal pe. vehem ammude hahoraa umehem chok umishpat yotze lechol yisrael. vaalehen hivticha tora shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 11)</small> "al pi hattora asher yorucha" zo mitzvat ase. vechol hammaamin bemoshe rabbenu uvetorato chayyav lismoch maase haddat alehen velishshaen alehen: 
Kol mi sheeno ose kehoraatan over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 11)</small> "lo tasur mikkol haddavar asher yaggidu lecha yamin usemol". veen lokin al lav ze mippene shennittan leazharat mitat bet din. shekkol chacham shemmore al divrehem mitato bechenek shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 12)</small> "vehaish asher yaase vezadon" vegomer. echad devarim shellamdu otan mippi hashshemua vehem tora shebbeal pe. veechad devarim shellemmadum mippi datam beachat min hammiddot shehattora nidreshet bahen venira beenehem sheddavar ze kach hu. veechad devarim sheasaum seyag lattora ulefi ma shehashshaa tzericha vehen haggezerot vehattakkanot vehamminhagot. kol echad veechad meellu hashshelosha devarim mitzvat ase lishmoa lahen. vehaover al kol echad mehen over belo taase. hare hu omer <small>(Devarim 17 11)</small> "al pi hattora asher yorucha" ellu hattakkanot vehaggezerot vehamminhagot sheyyoru bahem larabbim kede lechazzek haddat uletakken haolam. veal hammishpat asher yomru ellu devarim sheyyilmedu otan min haddin beachat min hammiddot shehattora nidreshet bahen. mikkol haddavar asher yaggidu lecha zo hakkabbala shekkibbelu ish mippi ish: 
Divre kabbala en bahen machloket leolam vechol davar shettimtza bo machloket beyadua sheeno kabbala mimmoshe rabbenu. udevarim shellemedin min haddin im hiskimu alehen bet din haggadol kullan hare hiskimu. veim nechleku bahen holchin achar harov umotziin haddin achar harabbim. vechen haggezerot vehattakkanot vehamminhagot im rau miktzatan sherauy ligzor gezera o letakken takkana o sheyyanichu haam hamminhag hazze verau miktzatan sheen rauy ligzor gezera zo velo letakken takkana zo velo lehaniach minhag ze nosin venotnin ellu keneged ellu veholchin achar rubban umotziin haddavar achar harabbim: 
Keshehaya bet din haggadol kayyam lo hayta machloket beyisrael. ella kol din shennolad bo safek leechad miyyisrael shoel levet din shebbeiro. im yadu amru lo. im lav hare hashshoel im oto bet din o im sheluchav olin lirushalayim veshoalin levet din shebbehar habbayit. im yadu amru lo. im lav hakkol bain levet din sheal petach haazara. im yadu amru lahen veim lav hakkol bain lelishkat haggazit levet din haggadol veshoalin. im haya haddavar shennolad bo hassafek lakkol yadua etzel bet din haggadol ben mippi hakkabbala ben mippi hammidda sheddanu bah omrim miyyad. im lo haya haddavar barur etzel bet din haggadol danin bo bishatan venosin venotnin baddavar ad sheyyaskimu kullan. o yaamdu leminyan veyelchu achar harov veyomru lechol hashshoalim kach halacha veholchin lahen. mishshebbatal bet din haggadol ravta machloket beyisrael ze metamme venoten taam lidvarav veze metaher venoten taam lidvarav ze oser veze mattir: 
Shene chachamim o shene batte dinin shennechleku shello bizman hassanhedrin o ad shello haya haddavar barur lahen. ben bizman echad ben baze achar ze. echad metaher veechad metamme echad oser veechad mattir. im encha yodea lehechan haddin note. beshel tora hallech achar hammachmir beshel sofrim hallech achar hammekel:
Mishneh Torah, Rebels 2:
Bet din haggadol sheddarshu beachat min hammiddot kefi ma shennira beenehem shehaddin kach vedanu din. veamad acharehem bet din acher venire lo taam acher listor oto. hare ze soter vedan kefi ma shennire beenav. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 9)</small> "el hashshofet asher yihye bayyamim hahem". encha chayyav lalechet ella achar bet din shebbedorcha: 
Bet din sheggazru gezera o tikkenu takkana vehinhigu minhag ufashat haddavar bechol yisrael. veamad acharehem bet din acher uvikkesh levattel devarim harishonim velaakor otah hattakkana veotah haggezera veoto hamminhag. eno yachol ad sheyyihye gadol min harishonim bechachma uveminyan. haya gadol bechachma aval lo beminyan. beminyan aval lo bechachma. eno yachol levattel et devarav. afillu batal hattaam shebbiglalo gazru harishonim o hitkinu en haacharonim yecholin levattel ad sheyyehu gedolim mehem. veheach yihyu gedolim mehem beminyan hoil vechol bet din uvet din shel shivim veechad hu. ze minyan chachme haddor shehiskimu vekibbelu haddavar sheamru bet din haggadol velo chalku bo: 
Bamme devarim amurim bidvarim shello asru otan kede laasot seyag lattora ella kishar dine tora. aval devarim sherau bet din ligzor uleasran laasot seyag im pashat issuran bechol [yisrael] en bet din gadol acher yachol leakran ulehattiran afillu haya gadol min harishonim: 
Veyesh levet din laakor af devarim ellu lefi shaa af al pi shehu katan min harishonim shello yehu gezerot ellu chamurin middivre tora atzmah sheafillu divre tora yesh lechol bet din leakro horaat shaa. ketzad. bet din sherau lechazzek haddat velaasot seyag kede shello yaavru haam al divre tora. makkin veonshin shello kaddin aval en kovin haddavar ledorot veomrim shehalacha kach hu. vechen im rau lefi shaa levattel mitzvat ase o laavor al mitzvat lo taase kede lehachezir rabbim laddat o lehatztzil rabbim miyyisrael millehikkashel bidvarim acherim osin lefi ma shetztzericha hashshaa. keshem sheharofe chotech yado o raglo shel ze kede sheyyichye kullo kach bet din morim bizman min hazzemannim laavor al ketzat mitzvot lefi shaa kede sheyyitkayyemu [kullam] kederech sheamru chachamim harishonim challel alav shabbat achat kede sheyyishmor shabbatot harebe: 
Bet din shennire lahen ligzor gezera o letakken takkana o lehanehig minhag tzerichin lehityashshev baddavar veleda techilla im rov hatztzibbur yecholin laamod bahen o im en yecholin laamod. uleolam en gozrin gezera al hatztzibbur ella im ken rov hatztzibbur yecholin laamod bah: 
Hare sheggazru bet din gezera vedimmu sherov hakkahal yecholin laamod bah. veachar sheggezaruha pikpeku haam bah velo pashta berov hakkahal hare zo betela veenan rashshain lachof et haam lalechet bah: 
Gazru vedimmu sheppashta bechol yisrael veamad haddavar ken shanim rabbot uleachar zeman merubbe amad bet din acher uvadak bechol yisrael veraa sheen otah haggezera poshetet bechol yisrael. yesh lo reshut levattel vaafillu haya pachut mibbet din harishon bechachma uveminyan: 
Vechol bet din shehittir shene devarim al yemaher lehattir davar shelishi: 
Hoil veyesh levet din ligzor veleesor davar hammuttar veyaamod issuro ledorot vechen yesh lahen lehattir issure tora lefi shaa. mahu ze shehizhira tora <small>(Devarim 13 1)</small> "lo tosif alav velo tigra mimmennu". shello lehosif al divre tora velo ligroa mehen velikboa haddavar leolam bedavar shehu min hattora ben battora shebbichtav ben battora shebbeal pe. ketzad. hare katuv battora <small>(Shemot 23 19)</small> "lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo". mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze hakkatuv asar levashshel vleechol basar bechalav. ben besar behema ben besar chayya. aval besar haof muttar bechalav min hattora. im yavo bet din veyattir besar chayya bechalav hare ze gorea. veim yeesor besar haof veyomar shehu bichlal haggedi vehu asur min hattora hare ze mosif. aval im amar besar haof muttar min hattora veanu neesor oto venodia laam shehu gezera shello yavo min haddavar chova veyomru haof muttar mippene shello nitparesh kach hachayya mutteret shehare lo nitparsha. veyavo acher lomar af besar behema mutteret chutz min haez. veyavo acher lomar af besar haez muttar bachalev para o hakkivsa shello neemar ella immo shehi mino. veyavo acher lomar af bachalev haez sheenah immo muttar shello neemar ella immo. lefichach neesor kol basar bechalav afillu besar of. en ze mosif ella ose seyag lattora. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Rebels 3:
Mi sheeno mode battora shebbeal pe eno zaken mamre haamur battora. ella hare ze bichlal haeppikorosin [umitato bechol adam]: 
Meachar shennitparsem shehu kofer battora shebbeal pe [moridin oto] velo maalin vahare hu kishar kol haeppikorosin vehaomrin en tora min hashshamayim vehammosrin vehammumarin. shekkol ellu enam bichlal yisrael veen tzarich lo leedim velo hateraa velo dayyanim [ella kol hahoreg echad mehen asa mitzva gedola vehesir hammichshol]: 
Bamme devarim amurim beish shekkafar battora shebbeal pe bemachashavto uvidvarim shenniru lo. vehalach achar dato hakkalla veachar sherirut libbo vechofer battora shebbeal pe techilla ketzadok uvaytos vechen kol hattoim acharav. aval bene hattoim haelle uvene benehem shehiddichu otam avotam venoldu ben hakkaraim vegiddelu otam al datam. hare hu ketinok shennishba benehem vegiddeluhu veeno zariz leechoz bedarche hammitzvot shehare hu keanus veaf al pi sheshshama achar kach [shehu yehudi veraa hayehudim vedatam hare hu keanus shehare giddeluhu al tautam] kach ellu sheamarnu haochazim bedarche avotam hakkaraim shettau. lefichach rauy lehacheziran bitshuva ulemashcham bedivre shalom ad sheyyachzeru leetan hattora: 
Aval zaken mamre haamur battora hu chacham echad mechachme yisrael sheyyesh beyado kabbala vedan umore bedivre tora kemo sheyyadunu veyoru kol chachme yisrael. shebbat lo machloket bedin min haddinim im bet din haggadol velo chazar ledivrehem ella chalak alehem vehora laasot shello kehoraatan. gazra alav tora mita umitvadde veyesh lo chelek laolam habba. af al pi shehu dan vehen danim hu kibbel vehem kibbelu hare hattora chalka lahem kavod. veim ratzu bet din limchol al kevodan ulehannicho enan yecholin kede shello yarbu machloket beyisrael: 
En zaken mamre chayyav mita ad sheyyehe chacham shehiggia lehoraa samuch bassanhedrin veyachlok al bet din bedavar shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat o bitfillin veyore laasot kehoraato. o yaase hu al pi horaato veyachlok alehen vehen yoshvin belishkat haggazit. aval im haya talmid shello higgia lehoraa vehora laasot patur. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 8)</small> "ki yippale mimmecha davar lammishpat" mi shello yippale mimmennu ella davar mufla: 
Haya chacham mufla shel bet din vechalak veshana velimmed laacherim kidvarav aval lo hora laasot patur. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 12)</small> "vehaish asher yaase vezadon" lo sheyyomar bezadon ella yore laasot o yaase hu beatzmo: 
Metzaan chutz limkoman vehimra alehen patur. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 8)</small> "vekamta vealita el hammakom" melammed shehammakom gorem lo mita. vechol ellu vechayyotze bahen shehen peturin min hammita yesh levet din haggadol lenaddotam ulehafrishan ulehakkotan ulemanan millelammed kefi ma sheyyerae lahen shehaddavar tzarich lechach: 
Vechetzad danin zaken mamre. beet sheyyippale davar veyore bo chacham hammaggia lehoraa ben bedavar sheyyerae beenav ben bedavar shekkibbel merabbotav. hare hu vehacholkin immo olin lirushalayim uvain levet din sheal petach har habbayit. omrim lahen bet din kach hu haddin. im shama vekibbel mutav veim lav bain kullan levet din sheal petach haazara veomrim lahem gam hem kach hu haddin. im kibbelu yelchu lahen veim lav kullan bain levet din haggadol lelishkat haggazit shemmishsham tora yotzet lechol yisrael shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 10)</small> "min hammakom hahu asher yivchar Adonai". uvet din omer lahem kach hu haddin veyotzin kullan. chazar ze hechacham leiro veshana velimmed kederech shehu lamud hare ze patur. hora laasot o sheasa kehoraato chayyav mita veeno tzarich hateraa. afillu natan taam lidvarav en shomin lo ella kevan shebbau edim sheasa kehoraato o shehora laacherim laasot gomrin dino lemita bevet din shebbeiro. vetofsin oto umaalin oto mishsham lirushalayim. veen memitin oto bevet din shebbeiro velo bevet din haggadol sheyyatza chutz lirushalayim ella maalin oto levet din haggadol shebbirushalayim. vead haregel meshammerin oto vechonkin oto baregel. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 12)</small> "vechol yisrael yishmeu veyirau" mikkelal shetztzarich hacheraza. vearbaa tzerichin hacheraza. zaken mamre. veedim zommin. vehammesit. uven sorer umore. shehare bechullan neemar yishmeu veyirau:
Mishneh Torah, Rebels 4:
Ze shechalak al bet din haggadol bedavar shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat. ben shehayu hen osrim vehu mattir ben shehayu hen mattirin vehu oser hare ze chayyav mita. afillu hu haya omer mippi hakkabbala veamar kach kibbalti merabbotay vehen omrim kach nire beenenu shehaddin noten. hoil venasa venatan alehen baddavar veasa o shehora laasot hare ze chayyav. veen tzarich lomar im hem morim mippi hakkabbala. vechen im chalak alehem bigzera min haggezerot sheggazru bedavar sheyyesh beshiggato chattat uzedono karet. kegon shehittir hechametz beyom arbaa asar benisan beshaa shishshit. o asaro bahanaa beshaa chamishit. hare ze chayyav mita. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Echad shennechleku bedavar shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat. o shennechleku bedavar hammevi lide davar shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat. ketzad. nechleku beishsha zo im hi erva im lav. im mare dam ze metamme beishsha o lo. im zo temea leda o lo. im zo zava o lo. im chelev ze asur o muttar. vechol kayyotze beellu. hare ze cholek bedavar shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat. vechetzad davar hammevi lide davar shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat kegon shennechleku beibbur shana im meabberim ad happurim o bechol adar hare ze chayyav shezze mevi lide chametz befesach. vechen im nechleku bedin middine mamonot o beminyan haddayyanin sheddanin dine mamonot hare ze chayyav. shehare lidvarav shel ze sheomer shezze chayyav laze kol shennatal mimmennu kedin natal veal pi bet din natal. velidvarav shel ze sheomer patur o sheamar sheen ellu reuyin ladun kol shennatal gezel hu beyado veim kiddesh bo ishsha enah mekuddeshet. uledivre haomer shello natal habba aleha bemezid anush karet beshogeg chayyav chattat venimtza haddavar mevi lide davar shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat. vechen im nechleku bedine makkot im ze chayyav malkot o eno o shechalak beminyan haddayyanim shellokin bifnehem hare ze chayyav shehare ledivre haomer eno loke chovlin hem bo vechayyavin leshallem vechol sheyyittol mehen kedin notel. uledivre haomer ben malkot hu kol sheyyittol mehen gezel hu beyado veim kiddesh bo ishsha enah mekuddeshet. vechen im nechleku baarachin o bacharamin im ze chayyav litten o eno hare ze chayyav. shehare ledivre haomer eno chayyav litten im lakchu mimmennu hare ze gezel vehamekaddesh bo ishsha enah mekuddeshet. vechen im chalak alehen befidyon kadashim im nifdu o lo nifdu hare ze chayyav shehare ledivre haomer en ze pidyon im kiddesh bo ishsha enah mekuddeshet. vechen im nechleku baarifat haegla im ellu chayyavin lehavi o lo hare ze chayyav shehare ledivre haomer chayyavim lehavi hare hi asura bahanaa vehamekaddesh bo ishsha enah mekuddeshet. vechen im nechleku bearla. vechen im nechleku beleket shichcha ufea im ze laaniyyim o levaal habbayit hare ze chayyav shehare ledivre haomer levaal habbayit hare ze gezel beyad heani veim kiddesh bo ishsha enah mekuddeshet. vechen im chalak alehen beav meavot hattuma kegon nige basar o nige battim o nige begadim hare ze chayyav shehare ledivre haomer tahor muttar lehikkanes bammikdash leechol kadashim uledivre haomer tame im nichnas o achal bemezid anush karet uveshogeg chayyav chattat. vechen im nechleku betohorat metzora im yesh laze tohora o en lo. vechen im nechleku behashekaat sota im zo tzericha lishtot o enah tzericha hare ze chayyav shehare ledivre haomer tzericha im met habbaal kodem shettishte hare zo asura livamah uledivre haomer enah tzericha mityabbemet. vechen kol kayyotze baze tzerichin livdok velachkor im hayta machloket zo mevia lide davar ze vedavar ze mevi lide davar sheni afillu achar mea devarim im yavo bassof ledavar shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat. ben shehaya hazzaken mekel vehen machamirin ben shehaya hu machmir vehen mekilin chayyav: 
Veim lo tavi hammachaloket lide kach hare ze patur. chutz mimmitzvat tefillin bilvad. ketzad. hora lehosif totefet chamishit battefillin veyaasenna chamesh totafot hare ze chayyav. vehu sheyyaase battechilla arbaa battim kehilchatan veyavi chamishit vidabbek bachitzon. shehabbayit hachitzon sheeno roe et haavir tamid pasul. vechiyyuv zaken mamre al davar ze halacha mippi hakkabbala. aval im nechleku bishar mitzvot kegon shechalak bedavar middivre lulav o tzitzit o shofar ze omer pasul veze omer kasher. ze omer yatza yede chovato veze omer lo yatza. ze omer tahor veze omer sheni letuma hare ze patur min hammita. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Rebels 5:
Hamekalel aviv veimmo niskal shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 20 9)</small> "aviv veimmo killel damav bo". veechad hamekallel bechayyehen o leachar mitatan hare ze niskal. vetzarich edim vehateraa kishar kol mechuyyave mitot bet din. veechad haish veechad haishsha vechen hattumtum vehaanderoginus. vehu sheyyihyu gedolim shehiggiu lichlal hoonashin: 
Eno chayyav sekila ad sheyyekallelem beshem min hashshemot hammeyuchadin. aval im killelam bechinnuy patur min hassekila. veloke kederech shelloke al killat kol adam kasher miyyisrael: 
Vechen hamekallel avi aviv vaavi immo hare ze kimkallel echad mishshear hakkahal: 
Azhara shel mekallel aviv veimmo minnayin. onesh shamanu beferush aval haazhara hare hi bichlal lo tekallel cheresh. hoil vehu muzhar shello lekallel adam miyyisrael hare aviv bichlal yisrael: 
Hammakke aviv veimmo mitato bechenek shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 15)</small> "makke aviv veimmo mot yumat". vetzarich edim vehateraa kishar kol mechuyyave mitat bet din. veechad haish veechad haishsha vechen hattumtum veanderoginus vehu sheyyaggiu lichlal onashin. eno chayyav chenek ad sheyyaase bahen chabbura aval im lo asa bahen chabbura hare ze kemakke echad miyyisrael. vehammakke otan leachar mita patur: 
Mi shehikka et aviv al azno vechersho chayyav veneherag. shei efshar sheyyease cheresh belo chabbura ella yatzat tippat dam bifnim baozen venitcharesh: 
Hammakkiz dam leaviv o shehaya rofe vechatach lo basar o evar patur. af al pi shehu patur lechattechilla lo yaase. o lehotzi sillon mibbesar aviv o immo lo yotzi shemma yaase chabbura. bamme devarim amurim kesheyyesh sham acher laasot. aval im en sham mi sheyyaase ella hu vahare hen mitztaarin hare ze makkiz vechotech kefi ma sheyyarshehu laasot: 
Azhara shel makke aviv minnayin. onesh shamanu azhara lo shamanu. hoil vehu muzhar shello lehakkot adam miyyisrael hare aviv veimmo bichlal: 
Shetuki chayyav al immo veeno chayyav al aviv af al pi shennivdeka immo veamra ben peloni hu eno niskal o nechnak al piha. aval beno min hashshifcha umin haakkum eno chayyav lo al aviv velo al immo. vechen ger shehorato shello bikdushsha af al pi shelledato bikdushsha eno chayyav al makkat aviv vekillato: 
Keshem sheeno chayyav al aviv kach eno chayyav al immo. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 17)</small> "umekallel aviv veimmo" et shehu chayyav al aviv chayyav al immo veze sheeno chayyav al aviv eno chayyav al immo: 
Hagger asur lekallel aviv haakkum ulehakkoto. velo yevazzehu kede shello yomru bau mikkedushsha chamura likdushsha kalla shehare ze mevazze aviv. ella noheg bo miktzat kavod. aval haeved en lo yichus ella hare aviv kemi sheeno aviv lechol davar af al pi shennishtachreru: 
Mi shehayu aviv veimmo reshaim gemurim veovre averot. afillu nigmar dinan lahariga vehem yotzim lehareg asur lehakkotan ulekallelam. veim killel o chaval bahen patur. veim asu teshuva hare ze chayyav veneherag alehen af al pi shehare hen yotzin lemita. bamme devarim amurim bivno. aval acher shebba vehikkahu vekillel achar shennigmar dino af al pi sheasa teshuva hare ze patur hoil vehu holech lemita. veim biyyesho chayyav biknas hamevayyesh: 
Avar aviv veimmo al avera shellokin aleha vehaya hu chazzan lifne haddayyanim lo yakke otam. vechen im nitchayyev nidduy lo yihye shaliach lenaddotam. velo yidchof otam velo yevazze otam bishlichut bet din af al pi shehen reuyin lechach velo asu teshuva: 
Lakkol en habben naase shaliach lehakkoto ulekallelo chutz mimmesit umaddiach. shehare amra tora <small>(Devarim 13 9)</small> "lo tachmol velo techasse alav": 
Mi shennitchayyev shevua livno kach rainu bo tamid sheeno mashbio bishvuat haala. shehare ze ba lekillat aviv. ella mashbio shevua sheen bah ala. uchevar bearnu shehaav sheharag et beno en echad meechav shel neherag naase goel haddam. velo al hakkaa velo al hakkelala bilvad hikpida tora ella af al habbizzayon. shekkol hamevazze aviv o immo afillu bidvarim vaafillu birmiza hare ze arur mippi haggevura. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 27 16)</small> "arur makle aviv veimmo". vahare hu omer <small>(Mishlei 30 17)</small> "ayin tilag leav vetavuz likkehat em" vegomer. veyesh levet din lehakkot al ze makkat mardut velaanosh kefi ma sheyyiru:
Mishneh Torah, Rebels 6:
Kibbud av vaem mitzvat ase gedola vechen mora av vaem. shakal otan hakkatuv bichvodo uvemorao. katuv <small>(Shemot 20 12)</small> "kabbed et avicha veet immecha" vechatuv <small>(Mishlei 3 9)</small> "kabbed et Adonai mehonecha". uveaviv veimmo katuv <small>(Vayikra 19 3)</small> "ish immo veaviv tirau" vechatuv <small>(Devarim 6 13)</small> "et Adonai elohecha tira". kederech shetztzivva al kevod shemo haggadol umorao kach tzivva al kevodam umoraam: 
Hamekallel aviv o immo biskila vehamegaddef biskila. hinne hishva otan baonesh. hikdim av leem lechavod vehikdim em leav lemora lelammed sheshshenehem shavim ben lammora ben lechavod: 
E zehu mora vee zehu kavod. mora lo omed bimkomo. velo yoshev bimkomo. velo soter et devarav velo machria et devarav. velo yikra lo bishmo lo bechayyav velo bemoto. ella omer abba mari. haya shem aviv o shem rabbo keshem acherim meshanne et shemam. yerae li sheen nizhar bechach ella beshem shehu pele sheen hakkol dashin bo. aval hashshemot shekkorim bahen et haam kegon avraham yitzchak veyaakov moshe vechayyotze bahen bechol lashon uvechol zeman kore bahen laacherim shello befanav veen bechach kelum. e zehu kavod maachil umashke malbish umechasse mishshel haav. veim en mamon laav veyesh mamon labben kofin oto vezan aviv veimmo kefi ma shehu yachol. umotzi umachnis umeshammesho bishar haddevarim shehashshammashim meshammeshim bahen et harav. veomed mippanav kederech shehu omed mippene rabbo: 
Vehaav shehaya talmid beno en haav omed mippene habben aval habben omed mippene aviv af al pi shehu talmido vechayyav lechabbedo bishar derachav bishat asiyyat massao umattano vaasiyyat chafatzav. ketzad. hannishma bidvar aviv lemakom lo yomar maharuni bishvil atzmi pitruni bishvil atzmi. ella maharuni bishvil abba pitruni bishvil abba. vechen kol kayyotze baze. leolam yichlol bichlal devarav shehu choshesh bichvod aviv veshemmityare mimmennu: 
Vechayyav lechabbedo afillu leachar moto. ketzad. haya omer devar shemua mippiv lo yomar kach amar abba. ella omer kach amar abba mari ani kapparat mishkavo. bamme devarim amurim betoch shenem asar chodesh shelleachar mitato. aval leachar shenem asar chodesh omer zichrono lechayye haolam habba: 
Echad haish veechad haishsha chayyavin bemora vechavod. ella shehaish yesh beyado laasot vehaishsha en beyadah laasot shehare reshut acherim aleha. lefichach im nitgarsha o nitalmena hare shenehem shavim: 
Ad hechan hu kibbud av veem. afillu natlu kis shel zehuvim shello vehishlichu befanav layyam lo yachlimem velo yetzaer bifnehem velo yichos kenegdam ella yekabbel gezerat hakkatuv veyishtok. vead hechan moraan afillu haya lovesh begadim chamudot veyoshev barosh bifne hakkahal uva aviv veimmo vekaru begadav vehikkuhu berosho veyarku befanav lo yachlimem ella yishtok veyira veyifchad mimmelech malche hammelachim shetztzivvahu bechach. sheillu melech basar vadam gazar alav davar shehu metzaer yeter mizze lo haya yachol lefarkes baddavar. kal vachomer lemi sheamar vehaya haolam kirtzono: 
Af al pi shebbechach nitztavvenu asur leadam lehachebid ello al banav uledakdek bichvodo immahem shello yeviem lide michshol. ella yimchol veyitallem shehaav shemmachal al kevodo kevodo machul: 
Vehammakke beno gadol menaddin oto shehare hu over al velifne ivver lo titten michshol: 
Mi shennitrefa dato shel aviv o shel immo mishtaddel linhog immahem kefi datam ad sheyyerucham alehen. veim i efshar lo laamod mippene shennishtattu beyoter yenichem veyelech lo vitzavve acherim lehanehigam karauy lahem: 
Hammamzer chayyav bichvod aviv umorao af al pi shehu patur al makkato vekillato ad sheyyaase teshuva. afillu haya aviv rasha uvaal averot mechabbedo umityare mimmennu. raahu over al divre tora lo yomar lo abba avarta al divre tora ella yomar lo abba katuv battora kach vechach keillu hu shoel mimmennu velo kemazhiro: 
Mi sheamar lo aviv laavor al divre tora ben sheamar lo laavor al mitzvat lo taase o levattel mitzvat ase afillu shel divrehem. hare ze lo yishma lo shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 3)</small> "ish immo veaviv tirau veet shabbetotay tishmoru". kullechem chayyavin bichvodi: 
Amar lo aviv hashekeni mayim veyesh beyado laasot mitzva im efshar lammitzva shettease al yede acherim tease veyitassek bichvod aviv sheen mevattelin mitzva mippene mitzva. veim en sham acherim laasotah yitassek bammitzva veyaniach kavod aviv shehu veaviv chayyavim bidvar mitzva. vetalmud tora gadol mikkevod av vaem: 
Amar lo aviv hashekeni mayim veamra lo immo hashekeni mayim meniach kevod immo veosek bichvod aviv techilla mippene shehu veimmo chayyavin bichvod aviv: 
Chayyav adam lechabbed et eshet aviv af al pi sheenah immo kol zeman sheaviv kayyam shezze bichlal kevod aviv. vechen mechabbed baal immo kol zeman sheimmo kayyemet. aval leachar mitatah eno chayyav. umiddivre sofrim sheyyihye adam chayyav bichvod achiv haggadol kichvod aviv:
Mishneh Torah, Rebels 7:
Ben sorer umore haamur battora hare nitparsha bo sekila velo anash hakkatuv ella im ken hizhir. vehechan hizhir lo tochlu al haddam lo tochal achila hammevia lide shefichut damim vezo achilat ben sorer umore sheeno neherag ella al achila mechoeret sheachal. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 20)</small> "zolel vesove" mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzolel hu haochel basar beraavtanut vesove hashshote yayin beraavtanut: 
Achila zo shehu chayyav aleha devarim harebe yesh bahem vehen kullan halacha mippi hakkabbala. eno chayyav sekila ad sheyyignov mishshel aviv veyikne basar bezol veyayin bezol. veyochal veyishte chutz mershut aviv bachavura shekkullan rekanin ufechutin. veyochal habbasar chay veeno chay mevushshal veeno mevushshal kederech shehaggannavim ochlim. veyishte hayyayin mazug kederech shehaggargeranim shotim. vehu sheyyochal mishkal chamishshim dinarin mibbasar ze bimlugema achat veyishte chatzi log miyyayin ze bevat achat. ganav mishshel aviv veachal achila zo birshut aviv. o shegganav mishshel acherim veachal achila zo hamechoeret ben birshut aviv ben birshut acherim. hare ze patur. vechen im ganav mishshel aviv veachal achila mechoeret kazo birshut acherim vehayta achilat mitzva afillu middivrehem [o achilat avera afillu middivrehem] patur shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 20)</small> "enennu shomea beklenu" sheeno over baachila zo ella al kolam. yatza ze sheavar bah al divre tora. o sheachalah bidvar mitzva. ketzad. achal achila zo hamechoeret im hachavura haraa sheochel immahem bidvar mitzva. o sheachalo maaser sheni birushalayim afillu achalo betanchume avelim shehi mitzva middivrehem hare ze patur. vechen im achalah minnevelot uterefot shekatzim uremasim. afillu achal betaanit tzibbur shehi avera middivrehem. hare ze patur min hammita: 
Achal kol maachol velo achal besar behema af al pi sheachal achila zo mibbesar haof patur. veim achal achila zo mibbesar behema vehishlim hachamishshim dinarim mibbesar haof chayyav. shata kol mashke velo shata yayin patur: 
Achal basar chay veshata yayin chay patur shezze keri hu veen adam yachol lehimmashech baze. vechen im achal basar maliach bayyom hashshelishi limlichato o shata yayin miggitto patur sheen adam yachol lehimmashech baze: 
Lo anash hakkatuv katan shello ba lichlal hammitzvot. vechen ish sheggadal vahare hu birshut atzmo eno niskal mippene shegganav veachal veshata achila zo hamechoeret. ha ketzad. mippi hashshemua lamdu sheen din ze ella beven shelosh esre shana veyom echad shehevi shete searot ad sheyyakkif kol haggid veachar sheyyakkif hassear kol haggid hare hu birshut atzmo veeno niskal: 
Kol yamav shel ben sorer umore enan ella shelosha chodashim meachar sheyyavi shete searot. lefi sheefshar shettitabber ishto veyihye ubbarah nikkar bishlosha chodashim veneemar <small>(Devarim 21 18)</small> "ki yihye leish ben sorer umore" velo av sorer umore ha lamadta sheim hikkif hassear et kol haggid kodem sheyyashlim shelosha chodashim hare ze patur: 
Ketzad danin ben sorer umore. meviin oto aviv veimmo techilla levet din shel shelosha veomrin lahen benenu ze sorer umore. umeviin shene edim shegganav mishshel aviv vekana basar veyayin bema shegganav veachal otah achila haamura achar hahatraa. vezo hi edut harishona umalkin oto kishar chayyave malkot. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 18)</small> "veyisseru oto velo yishma alehem". chazar veganav mishshel aviv veachal achila zo. aviv veimmo meviin oto levet din shel shelosha veesrim umeviin shene edim umeidin alav shegganav veachal achila zo haamura achar shehitru bo. vezo hi edut acharona afillu hayu hashshenayim harishonim hem haacharonim. veachar shemmekabbelin edutan bodkin oto shemma hikkif hassear et kol haggid. im lo hikkif velo shalmu lo shelosha chodashim gomrin dino kederech kol haruge bet din vesoklin oto. veeno niskal ad sheyyehu sham shelosha harishonim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 20)</small> "benenu ze" zehu shellaka bifnechem: 
Veim machalu lo aviv veimmo kodem sheyyiggamer dino patur: 
Barach ad shello nigmar dino veachar kach hikkif hassear millematta patur. veim mishshennigmar dino barach afillu hizkin kol et sheyyimmatze yissakel shekkol mi shennigmar dino hare hu keharug veen lo dam: 
Haya aviv rotze veimmo enah rotza immo rotza veaviv eno rotze eno naase ben sorer umore shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 19)</small> "vetafsu vo aviv veimmo". haya echad mehen giddem o chigger o illem o suma o cheresh eno naase ben sorer umore shenneemar vetafsu vo velo giddemim. <small>(Devarim 21 19)</small> "vehotziu oto" velo chiggerim. <small>(Devarim 21 20)</small> "veamru" velo illemim. <small>(Devarim 21 20)</small> "benenu ze" velo sumim. <small>(Devarim 21 20)</small> "enennu shomea beklenu" velo chershim: 
Gezerat hakkatuv hu sheyyissakel ben sorer umore. aval habbat enah niddonet bedin ze sheen darkah lehimmashech baachila ushetiyya keish. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 18)</small> "ben" velo bat velo tumtum veanderoginus: 
Tumtum shennikra venimtza zachar eno naase ben sorer umore. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 18)</small> "ki yihye leish ben sorer umore" ad sheyyihye ben mishsheat hateraa: 
Ben sorer umore tzarich hacheraza. ketzad machrizin alav. kotvin lechol yisrael bevet din peloni sakalnu peloni mippene shehaya ben sorer umore: 
Ben sorer umore hare hu kechol haruge bet din shemmamonam leyorshehen sheaf al pi sheaviv garam lo sekila hare hu yoresh kol nechasav: seliku lehu hilchot mamrim besad
Mishneh Torah, Mourning 1:
Mitzvat ase lehitabbel al hakkerovim. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 10 19)</small> "veachalti chattat hayyom hayyitav beene Adonai". veen avelut min hattora ella beyom rishon bilvad shehu yom hammita veyom hakkevura. aval shear hashshiva yamim eno din tora. af al pi shenneemar battora <small>(Bereshit 50 10)</small> "vayyaas leaviv evel shivat yamim" nittena tora venitchaddesha halacha. umoshe rabbenu tikken lahem leyisrael shivat yeme avelut veshivat yeme hammishte: 
Meematay yitchayyev adam baevel. mishsheyyissatem haggolel. aval kol zeman shello nikbar hammet eno asur bedavar min haddevarim shehaavel asur bahen. umippene taam ze rachatz david vesach keshemmet hayyeled terem sheyyikkaver: 
Haruge malchut sheen menichin otan lehikkaver meematay matchilin lehitabbel alehen velispor shiva usheloshim mishsheyyityaashu lishl lammelech lekavran. af al pi shello nityaashu millignov otan: 
Mi shettava bannahar o mi sheachalattu chayya raa. mishshennityaashu levakkesh. metzauhu evarim evarim en monin lo ad sheyyimmatze rosho verubbo o yityaashu millevakkesh: 
Mi sheddarkan lishloach hammet limdina acheret lekavro veenam yodim matay yikkaver meet sheyyachzeru penehen millelauoto matchilin limnot shiva usheloshim umatchilin lehitabbel: 
Hannefalim en mitabbelin alehen. vechol shello shaha sheloshim yom baadam hare ze nefel. afillu met beyom sheloshim en mitabbelin alav: 
Veim noda bevadday shennolad letisha chodashim gemurim afillu met bayyom shennolad mitabbelim alav: 
Ben tisha chodashim shennolad met uven shemona shemmet afillu leachar sheloshim. umi sheyyatza mechuttach o merussas af al pi shekkalu lo chodashav. hare ze nefel veen mitabbelin alehen velo mitassekin immahem: 
Kol haruge malchut af al pi shennehergu bedin hammelech vehattora natna lo reshut lehargan. hare ellu mitabbelin alehen veen monin mehen kol davar. umamonam lammelech. venikbarin bekivre avotehen. aval kol haruge bet din en mitabbelin alehen aval onnin. sheen aninut ella ballev. veen nikbarin im avotehen ad sheyyitakkel habbasar. umamonam leyorshehem: 
Kol happorshin middarche tzibbur vehem haanashim shepparku ol hammitzvot meal tzavvaran veen nichlalin bichlal yisrael baasiyyat hammitzvot uvichvod hammoadot vishivat batte kenesiyyot uvatte midrashot ella hare hen kivne chorin leatzman [kishar haummot] vechen haeppikorosin [vehammumarim] vehammosrin kol ellu en mitabbelin alehen. ella achehem ushear kerovehem lovshin levanim umitattefim levanim veochlim veshotim usemechim shehare avdu sonav shel hakkadosh baruch hu. vaalehem hakkatuv omer <small>(Tehillim 139 21)</small> "halo mesanecha Adonai esna": 
Hameabbed atzmo ladaat en mitassekin immo lechol davar veen mitabbelin alav veen maspidin oto. aval omdin alav beshura veomrin alav birkat avelim vechol davar shehu kavod lachayyim. vee zehu hameabbed atzmo ladaat. lo sheala laggag venafal umet ella haomer hareni ole lerosh haggag. rauhu sheala miyyad derech kaas o shehaya metzer venafal umet. hare ze bechezkat sheibbed atzmo ladaat. aval im rauhu chanuk vetaluy bailan o harug umushlach al gav sefo hare ze bechezkat kol hammetim umitassekin immo veen monin mimmennu davar:
Mishneh Torah, Mourning 2:
Elu sheadam chayyav lehitabbel alehen din tora. immo veaviv beno uvitto veachiv vaachoto meaviv. umiddivrehem sheyyitabbel haish al ishto hannesua. vechen haishsha al balah. umitabbel al achiv veal achoto shehen meimmo: 
Afillu hakkohen sheeno mittamme leachiv vaachoto meimmo velaachoto hannesua af al pi shehi meaviv. mitabbel hu alehen. veim hayta achoto zo hannesua meaviv hare hu mitabbel aleha din tora: 
Beno o achiv habba min hashshifcha umin hannachrit eno mitabbel alehen kelal. vechen mi shennitgayyer hu uvanav o nishtachrer hu veimmo en mitabbelin ze al ze. vechen ishto arusa eno mitabbel aleha velo onen vechen hi lo onenet velo mitabbelet alav: 
Kol kerovim shehu chayyav lehitabbel alehen hare ze mitabbel immahem bifnehem middivre sofrim. ketzad. hare shemmet ben beno o achi beno o em beno chayyav likroa bifne beno velinhog avelut befanav aval shello befanav eno chayyav. vechen bishar hakkerovim: 
Ishto hannesua af al pi shehu mitabbel aleha eno mitabbel immah al shear kerovim ella al aviha veal immah mishshum kevod ishto noheg avelut alehen befaneha. ketzad. mi shemmet chamiv o chamoto kofe mittato venoheg avelut im ishto befaneha aval lo shello befaneha. vechen haishsha shemmet chamiha o chamotah noheget avelut befanav. aval shear kerovim kegon shemmet achi ishto o benah vehaishsha shemmet achi balah o beno en mitabbelin ze al ze. vechen yerae li sheim meta eshet kerovo o baal kerovato kegon shemmeta eshet beno o baal bitto eno chayyav lehitabbel alehen. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
