Kamma chamura mitzvat avelut. shehare nidchet lo hattuma mippene kerovav kede sheyyitassek immahen veyitabbel alehen. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 2)</small> "ki im lishero hakkarov elav leimmo" vegomer <small>(Vayikra 21 3)</small> "lah yittamma" mitzvat ase sheim lo ratza lehittame metammein oto al karcho. bamme devarim amurim bizcharim shehuzharu al hattuma aval hakkohanot hoil veenan muzharot al hattuma ken enan metzuuot lehittamme lakkerovim. ella im ratzu mittammeot veim lav lo mittammeot: 
Ishto shel kohen mittamme lah al karcho. veeno mittamme lah ella middivre sofrim. asauha kemet mitzva. kevan sheen lah yoresh ella hu lo timtza mi sheyyitassek bah. veeno mittamme ella linsuah bilvad aval haarusa eno mittamme lah: 
Vechen kol otan sheamru sheen mitabbelin alehen kegon haruge bet din veshepparshu middarche tzibbur vehannefalim vehameabbed atzmo ladaat en hakkohen mittamme lahen. vead matay metzuvve lehittamme likrovav ad sheyyissatem haggolel. aval meachar shennistam haggolel hare hen kishar kol hammetim sheim nitma bahen loke: 
Ishto happesula eno mittamme lah. lefichach mi sheshshama shemua shemmet balah venisset uva balah. shenehen en mittammein lah shehare hi pesula lishnehen. aval mittamme hu leimmo af al pi shehi chalala. vechen mittamme livno ulevitto uleachiv velaachoto af al pi shehen pesulin. afillu hayu mamzerim mittamme lahen: 
Achoto hannesua eno mittamme lah af al pi shehi nesua lechohen. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 3)</small> "habbetula hakkerova elav asher lo hayta leish". habbetula perat laanusa umefutta. yachol sheani motzi et habbogeret umukkat etz talmud lomar asher lo hayta leish mi shehavayatah bide ish. asher lo hayta leish perat laarusa sheeno mittamme lah af al pi shehi arusa lechohen: 
Nitgarsha achoto min haerusin mittamme lah. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 3)</small> "hakkerova elav" lehavi et hamegoreshet min haerusin: 
Achiv vaachoto meimmo eno mittamme lahen. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 2)</small> "velivno ulevitto uleachiv" <small>(Vayikra 21 3)</small> "velaachoto". ma beno harauy lirushshato af achiv vaachoto haruyim lirushshato: 
Hassefekot eno mittamme lahen shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 3)</small> "lah yittamma" mittamme hu al havvadday veeno mittamme al hassafek. lefichach havveladot shennitarvu vehabben shehu safek ben shiva laacharon o ben tisha larishon vechen kol kayyotze bahen eno mittamme lahen missafek. vechen kol hammitgareshet sefek gerushin o beget pasul eno mittamme lah: 
En hakkohen mittamme leever min hachay meaviv velo leetzem meatzmot aviv. vechen hamelakket atzmot aviv eno mittamme lahen af al pi shehashshidra kayyemet: 
Nikta rosho shel aviv eno mittamme lo shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 2)</small> "leaviv" bizman shehu shalem velo bizman shehu chaser. vechen shear hakkerovim. hattuma lakkerovim dechuya hi velo huttera lakkol. lefichach asur lechohen lehittamme lemet afillu beet shemmittamme likrovav shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 3)</small> "lah yittamma" eno mittamme laacherim immah. shello yomar hoil venitmeti al avi alakket atzmot peloni o egga bekever peloni. lefichach kohen shemmet lo met tzarich lehizzaher ulekavro besof bet hakkevarot kede shello yikkanes levet hakkevarot velo yittamme bekivrot acherim kesheyyikbor meto:
Mishneh Torah, Mourning 3:
Kol kohen shennitma lemet chutz mishshishsha metim hameforashim battora o ishto. beedim vehateraa. hare ze loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 1)</small> "lenefesh lo yittamma beammav". veechad hannogea bemet o hammaahil o hannose. veechad hammet veechad shear hattumot happorshot min hammet shenneemar lenefesh lo yittamma beammav. uchevar perashnu behilchot tumat met kol devarim hametammein min hammet min hattora o middivrehem: 
Vechen im naga hakkohen bekever loke. aval nogea hu bivgadim shennagu bemet af al pi shemmittamme bahen tumat shiva: 
Vechen im nichnas leohel tame shennichnesa lo hattuma loke. af al pi sheatzmah shel tuma bevayit acher. uchevar bearnu kol haohalim shettikkanes lahen hattuma o shettetze mehen vedin hassechachot vehapperaot. vechol haddevarim hammeviin et hattuma vehachotztzin bifne hattuma. vee ze mehen din tora vee ze mehen middivrehen. hakkol behilchot tumat met. vesham bearnu sheen akkum metammein beohel ulefichach kivrotehem tehorim umuttar lechohen likkanes lesham velidroch al kivrotehem. veeno asur ella sheyyigga battuma o sheyyissaenna kemo shebbearnu sham: 
Kohen shennichnas leohel hammet o levet hakkevarot bishgaga veachar sheyyada hitru bo im kafatz veyatza patur. veim yashav sham kede hishtachavaya kemo shebbearnu beinyan tumat mikdash hare ze loke. nichnas veyatza vechazar venichnas veyatza im hitru bo al kol paam ufaam loke al kol kenisa uchenisa. vechen im naga bemet vehitru bo uferash vechazar venaga vehitru bo afillu mea peamim loke al kol achat veachat. haya nogea velo perash o shehaya omed bevet hakkevarot venaga bemetim acherim. af al pi shehitru bo kamma peamim eno loke ella achat shehare mechullal veomed kol zeman shello perash: 
Hametamme et hakkohen. im hayu shenehem mezidin hare hakkohen loke veze shettimmeo over al velifne ivver lo titten michshol. haya hakkohen shogeg veze shettimmeo mezid hare ze shettimmeo loke: 
Kohen gadol eno mittamme likrovim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 11)</small> "leaviv uleimmo lo yittamma". vechen eno nichnas im hammet beohel afillu kerovav. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 11)</small> "veal kol nafshot met lo yavo". ha lamadta shehu chayyav belo yavo vechayyav belo yittamma. ketzad. naga o nasa loke achat. nichnas leohel veyashav sham ad shemmet alav hammet. o shennichnas leshidda teva umigdal uva chavero ufara alav gag hashshidda shehare tuma uvia bain keechad. hare ze loke shetayim mishshum lo yavo umishshum lo yittamma: 
Nitma mikkodem veachar kach nichnas leohel im hitru bo loke af al habbia: 
Kohen sheppaga bemet mitzva badderech hare ze mittamme lo. afillu kohen gadol chayyav lehittamme lo ulekavro. veezehu met mitzva. echad miyyisrael shehaya mushlach badderech veen lo kovrin. davar ze halacha mippi hakkabbala. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya hakkohen levaddo veen immo acher vaafillu kara shem badderech veen lo one. aval im kesheyyikra acherim onim oto en ze met mitzva ella yikra laacherim veyavou veyaasku bo: 
Hayu kohen venazir mehallechin bederech ufagu bemet mitzva. yitassek bo hannazir lefi sheen kedushshato kedushshat olam veal yittame bo hakkohen af al pi shehu kohen hedyot. haya kohen gadol vechohen hedyot yittame hahedyot. vechol hakkodem et chavero bemaala mitacher betuma. usegan im meshuach milchama sheppagu bemet mitzva yittame meshuach milchama veal yittame hassegan: 
Nasi shemmet hakkol mittammein lo afillu kohanim. asauhu kemet mitzva lakkol mippene shehakkol chayyavin bichvodo. vechen hakkol onnin alav: 
Benot aharon lo huzharu al tumat met shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 1)</small> "emor el hakkohanim bene aharon" velo benot aharon. vechen hachalalim muttarin lehittamme shenneemar bene aharon ad sheyyihyu bechihunam: 
Kohen katan hare haggedolim muzharim shello yetammeuhu. veim ba lehittamme meatzmo en bet din metzuvvin alav lehaferisho. aval aviv tzarich lechannecho bikdushsha: 
Met tofes arba ammot shello letuma. vechol kohen shennichnas letoch arba ammot makkin oto makkat mardut. vechen im nichnas levet happeras o yatza chutza laaretz. o shennitma bedam tevusa. o begolel uvedofek vechayyotze bahen. makkin oto makkat mardut. mippene shehen avot shel divrehem kemo shebbearnu behilchot tumat met. aval im nichnas levet hakkevarot loke min hattora: 
Muttar lechohen lehittamme bevet happeras o bechutza laaretz lidvar mitzva bizman sheen sham derech ella hi. kegon shehalach lissa ishsha o lilmod tora. af al pi sheyyesh sham mi sheyyelammedennu beeretz yisrael lo min hakkol adam zoche lilmod. vechen mittamme betuma middivrehem lichvod habberiyyot. ketzad. avel shehalach bevet happeras hakkol holchin acharav sham lenachamo. vechen medallegin al gabbe aronot shel metim likrat malche yisrael vaafillu malche akkum kede lehavechin benam leven malche yisrael kesheyyachzor kevodan limkoman. vechen kol kayyotze baze. vechen mittamme betuma shel divrehem ladun im haakkum ulearer immahen. mippene shehu matztzil miyyadam. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Mourning 4:
Minnehag yisrael bemetim uvikvura kach hu. meammetzin enav shel met. veim niftach piv koshrin et lechayav. ufokkin et nekavav achar shemmedichin oto. vesachin oto bemine besamim. vegozzin searo. umalbishin oto tachrichin tefurin bechut shel pishtan levanim. velo yihyu demehen yekarim. venahagu chachamim besudar sheve zuz shello levayyesh et mi sheen lo. umechassin pene hammet shello levayyesh et haaniyyim sheppenehem mushcharin baraav: 
Veasur likbor betachrichin shel meshi uvegadim hammuzhavin harkumin afillu lenasi shebbeyisrael. shezzehu gassut haruach vehashechata umaase akkum. vesovlin et hammet al hakkatef ad bet hakkevarot: 
Venose hammitta asurin binilat hassandal shemma tippasek retzua missandalo shel echad mehen venimtza mitakkev min hammitzva: 
Vechofrin baafar mearot veosin kuch betzad hammeara vekovrin oto bo ufanav lemala. umachzirin heafar vehaavanim alav. veyesh lahen likbor bearon shel etz. vehamelavvin oto omrin lo lech beshalom shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 15 15)</small> "veatta tavo el avotecha beshalom". umetzayyenin et kol bet hakkevarot uvonin nefesh al hakkever. vehatztzaddikim en bonim lahem nefesh al kivrotehem sheddivrehem hem zichronam. velo yifne adam levakker hakkevarot: 
Haggoses hare hu kechay lechol davar. en koshrin lechayav veen pokkin nekavav veen mannichin keli mattachot ucheli meker al tabburo shello yitpach. velo sachin oto. velo medichin oto. velo metilin oto al hachol velo al hammelach ad shaa sheyyamut. vehannogea bo hare ze shofech damim. lema ze dome lener shemmetaftef kevan sheyyigga bo adam yichbe. vechol hameammetz enav im yetziat nefesh hare ze shofech damim ella yishhe meat shemma nitallef. vechen en korin alav. velo choltzin katef. velo maspidin. velo machnisin immo aron vetachrichin babbayit ad sheyyamut: 
Mi shemmeto muttal lefanav ochel bevayit acher. en lo bayit acher ose mechitztza veochel. en lo davar laasot mechitztza machzir panav veochel. uven kach uven kach eno mesev veochel. velo ochel basar. velo shote yayin. veeno mevarech. veeno mezammen. veen mevarchin alav veen mezammenin alav. ufatur mikkeriat shema umin hattefilla umittefillin umikkol mitzvot haamurot battora. beshabbat mesev veochel basar veshote yayin. umevarech. umezammen. umevarchin alav umezammenin alav. vechayyav bechol mitzvot haamurot battora chutz mittashmish hammitta. nikbar hammet hare ze muttar leechol basar velishtot yayin meat kede lishrot achila shebbemeav aval lo lirvot: 
En mashhin et hammet ella madchin mittato miyyad. vechol hammadche mittato hare ze meshubbach. veal aviv veal immo hare ze megunne: 
Haya erev shabbat o erev yom tov o shehayu geshamim mezallefin al hammitta muttar. shello miher ella lichvod aviv veimmo. vechol hammelin et meto over belo taase ella im ken helino lichvodo ulehashlim tzerachav: 
Haavel beyom rishon bilvad asur lehaniach tefillin uleechol mishshello. vechayyav leshev al mitta kefuya. uvishar yeme haevel muttar lo leechol mishshello veleshev al gabbe mappatz o karka. umeniach tefillin. uminnayin shehu asur beyom rishon lehaniach tefillin. shehare neemar lichezkel <small>(Yechezkel 24 17)</small> "peercha chavosh alecha" michlal shekkol haam asurin. veneemar lo <small>(Yechezkel 24 17)</small> "velechem anashim lo tochel" michlal shekkol haam ochlin mishshel acherim beyom rishon vaasurin leechol mishshel atzman:
Mishneh Torah, Mourning 5:
Elu devarim shehaavel asur bahen beyom rishon min hattora uvishar yamim middivrehem. asur lesapper. ulechabbes. velirchotz. velasuch. uleshammesh mittato. velinol et hassandal. velaasot melacha. velikrot bedivre tora. velizkof et hammitta. velifroa et rosho. velishl shalom. hakkol achad asar davar: 
Uminnayin shehaavel asur betisporet. shehare hizhir bene aharon <small>(Vayikra 10 6)</small> "rashechem al tifrau". michlal shekkol hammitabbel asur lesapper searo ella megaddel pera. ucheshem sheasur legalleach sear rosho kach asur legalleach sear zekano vechol sear sheyyesh bo. echad hamegalleach veechad hammitgalleach. haya megalleach veshama shemmet aviv mashlim tiglachat searo echad hamegalleach veechad hammitgalleach. vechen asur legalleach safa velittol tzipparnav bichli aval beshinnav o shennotel tzipporen betzipporen muttar: 
Uminnayin shehaavel asur lechabbes begadav velirchotz gufo velasuch. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 2 14 2)</small> "hitabbeli na velivshi vigde evel veal tasuchi shemen". urechitza bichlal sicha sheharchitza kodemet lesicha shenneemar <small>(Rut 3 3)</small> "verachatzt vasacht". ucheshem sheavel asur bechibbus begadim kach asur lilbosh kelim levanim chadashim umegohatzin: 
Asur lasuch miktzat gufo kechol gufo. veim lehaavir et hazzuhama muttar. vechen asur birchitzat miktzat gufo bechammin. aval betzonen rochetz panav yadav veraglav aval lo kol gufo: 
Minnayin leavel sheasur betashmish hammitta. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 2 12 24)</small> "vaynachem david et bat sheva ishto vayyavo eleha vayyishkav immah". michlal shehaya asur mikkodem. vechen lo yissa haavel ishsha velo tinnase ishsha af al pi sheen meshammeshin mittatan. umuttar lehityached im ishto veaf al pi shehu asur betashmish hammitta: 
Minnayin shehaavel asur binilat hassandal. shehare neemar lichezkel <small>(Yechezkel 24 17)</small> "unealecha tasim beraglecha". michlal shekkol haam asurin. haya ba badderech noel veholech uchesheyyikkanes bammedina choletz minalav: 
Remez leavel sheasur baasiyyat melacha. ze shenneemar <small>(Amos 8 10)</small> "vehafachti chaggechem leevel" ma chag asur baasiyyat melacha af avel asur baasiyyat melacha. ucheshem shehu asur baasiyyat melacha kach hu asur lissa velitten bischora velelech mimmedina limdina bischora: 
Kol shelosha yamim harishonim asur baasiyyat melacha afillu haya ani hammitparnes min hatztzedaka. mikkan veelach im haya ani ose betzina betoch beto. vehaishsha to bappelech betoch beta: 
Shene achim o shene shuttafin shehayu bachanut achat veera evel leechad mehen. noalin et hachanut kol shiva: 
Afillu devarim shemmuttar laasotan bechullo shel moed asur leavel laasotan beyado bime evlo. aval acherim osim lo. ketzad. hayu zetav lahafoch vechaddav lagof ufishtano laalot min hammishra vetzamro min hayyora. socher acherim laasot lo kede shello yovdu. umerabbetzin lo sadehu mishshettaggia onat hammayim: 
Haarisin vehachachirin shello vehakkabbelanin hare ellu yaasu kedarkan. aval hachammarim vehaggammalim babbehemot shello vehassappanim bassefina shello hare ellu lo yaasu. veim hayu muchkarim o muskarim mikkodem lizman katzuv hare ellu yaasu: 
Sechir yom afillu beir acheret lo yaase lo: 
Haavel shehayta melechet acherim beyado ben bekabbelanut ben sheenah bekabbelanut lo yaase. hayta melachto beyad acherim. beveto lo yaasu bevayit acher osin: 
Haya lo din im adam eno tovo kol shivat yeme haavelut. veim haya davar aved ose shaliach. kaze horu haggeonim: 
Minnayin shehaavel asur bedivre tora. shehare neemar lichezkel <small>(Yechezkel 24 17)</small> "heanek dom": 
Asur likrot battora banneviim uvakketuvim velishnot bammishna uvammidrash uvahalachot. veim hayu rabbim tzerichin lo muttar uvilvad shello yaamid turgeman ella yilchosh leacher betziddo veze shebbetziddo omer latturgeman vehatturgeman mashmia larabbim: 
Uminnayin sheen haavel yoshev al hammitta. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 2 13 lo)</small> "vayyakam hammelech vayyikra et begadav vayyishkav artza": 
Vechayyav lichpot hammitta kol shiva. velo mittato bilvad hu kofe ella kol hammittot sheyyesh lo betoch beto hu kofe afillu eser mittot baasara battim uveeser ayarot chayyav lichpot et kullan. vaafillu chamishsha achim umet echad mehen kullan kofin et mittotehen. hammitta hameyuchedet lechelim o lemaot eno tzarich lichpotah. dargash eno tzarich lichpoto ella mattir et karbitav vehu nofel meelav. mitta shennakliteha yotzin mimmenna shehare i efshar lehafchah zokfah vedayyo. hafach kol mittotav vehaya hu yashen al gabbe mittot acherim o al gabbe kisse o al gabbe aron o al gabbe karka lo yatza yede chovato ella yashen al gabbe hammitta hakkefuya: 
Minnayin leavel sheasur bifriat harosh. shehare neemar lichezkel <small>(Yechezkel 24 17)</small> "lo tate al safam" michlal sheshshear haavelim chayyavin baatifat harosh. vehassudar shemmechasse bo rosho ote mimmiktzato meat al piv. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 13 45)</small> "veal safam yate" veuneklos tirgem kaavela yitattef: 
Uminnayin shehaavel asur bishelat shalom. shenneemar <small>(Yechezkel 24 17)</small> "heanek dom". kol shelosha yamim harishonim mi shennatan lo shalom en machzir lo ella modio shehu avel. umishshelosha vead shiva mi sheshshaal bishlomo machzir lo shalom. umishshiva vead sheloshim shoel bishlom acherim aval acherim en shoalin bishlomo ad leachar sheloshim. veal aviv veal immo en shoalin bishlomo ad leachar shenem asar chodesh. im bishelat shalom neesar beavel kal vachomer shehu asur leharebot devarim velischok shenneemar dom. velo yeechoz tinok beyado shello yeviennu lide sechok. velo yikkanes limkom simcha kegon batte hammishtaot vechayyotze bahen:
Mishneh Torah, Mourning 6:
Midivre sofrim sheyyihye haavel noheg bemiktzat divre avelut kol sheloshim yom. uminnayin samchu chachamim lishloshim yom. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 13)</small> "uvachta et aviha veet immah yerach yamim". michlal shehaavel mitztaer kol sheloshim yom: 
Veellu devarim shehaavel asur bahen kol sheloshim yom. asur betisporet. uvegihutz. uvenissuin. uvesimchat mereut. velelech bischora mimmedina limdina. hakkol chamishsha devarim: 
Betisporet ketzad. keshem sheasur lesapper kol sear gufo. o legalleach sefamo. o lakotz tzipparnav bichli kol shiva. kach asur kol sheloshim yom. bamme devarim amurim beish. aval beishsha mutteret bintilat sear leachar shiva vehaish ad sheloshim yom. veal aviv veal immo chayyav legaddel searo ad sheyyishlach pera o ad sheyyigaru bo chaverav: 
Vechen asur lilbosh kelim levanim chadashim umegohatzin kol sheloshim yom. echad haish veechad haishsha. hayu tzevuin umegohatzin muttarin. vechen im lo hayu chadashim af al pi shehen levanim umegohatzin muttarin. uchele pishtan en bahen mishshum gihutz. uleachar sheloshim yom muttar begihutz afillu al aviv veal immo: 
Benissuin ketzad. asur lissa ishsha kol sheloshim yom. umuttar learsah afillu beyom hammita. umi shemmeta ishto im kevar kiyyem mitzvat periyya ureviyya veyesh lo mi sheyyeshammeshennu veen lo banim ketannim hare ze asur lissa ishsha acheret ad sheyyaavru alav shelosha regalim. aval mi shello kiyyem mitzvat periyya ureviyya o shekkiyyem veyesh lo banim ketannim o sheen lo mi sheyyeshammeshennu hare ze muttar learsah velichnos miyyad. veasur lo lavo aleha ad sheloshim yom. vechen haishsha shehayta avela lo tibbael ad sheloshim yom: 
Simchat mereut shehaya chayyav lifroa otah miyyad. muttar laasotah miyyad leachar shiva. aval im eno chayyav lefarah asur lehikkanes lah ad sheloshim yom: 
Bamme devarim amurim bishar kol metim. aval al aviv veal immo ben kach uven kach lo yikkanes lesimchat mereut ad 12 chodesh: 
Al kol hammetim kullan muttar lelech bischora leachar sheloshim. al aviv veal immo ad sheyyigaru bo chaverav veyomru lo lech immanu: 
Al kol hammetim kullan ratza memaet beisko ratza eno memaet. al aviv veal immo memaet beisko: 
Haholech mimmakom lemakom im yachol lemaet beisko yemaet veim lav yikne tzarche hadderech udevarim sheyyesh bahen chayye nefesh: 
Mi shehaya balah tzaluv bair o ishto tzeluva o aviv veimmo. asur lo lishkon beotah hair ad sheyyichle habbasar. veim hayta ir gedola keantochya yesh lo lishkon batztzad haacher sheenan tzeluvin bo: 
Yom shevii miktzato kechullo vehu ole lechan ulechan. ulefichach muttar lechabbes velirchotz velaasot shear haddevarim beyom shevii. vechen yom sheloshim miktzato kechullo umuttar lesapper ulegahetz beyom sheloshim: 
Mi shettechafuhu avalav vehichbid searo mekel betaar lo bemisparayim. umechabbes kesuto bemayim aval lo beneter velo bechol. verochetz kol gufo betzonen aval lo bechammin. vechen mi shettechafuhu avalav uva mimmedinat hayyam umibbet hashshivya. o sheyyatza mibbet haasurim. o shehaya menudde vehuttar. o shehaya muddar venishal al nidro vehuttar. vechol hayyotze mittuma letohora. hare ellu megallechin bime evlam hoil utechafam evel achar evel velo matzu penay:
Mishneh Torah, Mourning 7:
Mi shebbaa lo shemua shemmet lo karov. im betoch sheloshim yom higgia hashshemua afillu yom sheloshim atzmo hare zo shemua kerova. vechayyav linhog shiva yeme avelut miyyom shehiggia hashshemua. vekorea umone sheloshim leissur hattisporet im shear haddevarim. kelalo shel davar yom shemuato hakkerova keyom hakkevura. aval im higgia lo hashshemua achar hashsheloshim yom hare zo shemua rechoka veenah noheget ella yom echad veeno korea. ucheillu yom hashshemua hu yom shevii veyom sheloshim umiktzat hayyom kechullo: 
Ketzad miktzat hayyom kechullo. kevan shennahag avelut shaa achat keillu nahag kol hayyom kullo. umuttar linol velirchotz velasuch ulegalleach bishar hayyom. vechen hu muttar bechol haddevarim: 
Mi shebbaa lo shemua kerova betoch haregel o beyom shabbat uleachar shabbat o achar haregel naaset rechoka. ole lo veeno noheg leachar haregel o leachar hashshabbat ella yom echad bilvad. umiktzat hayyom kechullo kemo shebbearnu: 
Mi shemmet lo karov velo yada ad shebba. im haya bemakom karov shehu mahalach asara parsaot sheefshar sheyyavo beyom echad. afillu ba bayyom hashshevii. im matza menachamim etzel gedol habbayit af al pi shenninaru laamod hoil umatza menachamim ole lo umone immahen tashlum sheloshim yom. veim lo matza menachamim mone leatzmo. vechen im haya bemakom rachok afillu ba beyom sheni mone leatzmo shiva usheloshim miyyom shebba: 
Avel bishlosha yamim harishonim eno holech afillu levet avel acher. mikkan veelach holech veeno yoshev bimkom hamenachamin ella bimkom hammitnachamin. velo yetze lemakom acher mippetach beto kol shabbat harishona. sheniyya yotze veeno yoshev bimkomo. shelishit yoshev bimkomo veeno medabber kedarko. reviit hare hu kechol adam: 
Kohen gadol chayyav bechol divre avelut. ella sheasur lo likroa begadav lemala ulegaddel pera velatzet achar hammitta. vechol haam bain lenachamo leveto. ucheshemmavrin oto kol haam mesubbin al haaretz vehu mesev al hassafsal. veomrin lo keshemmenachamin oto anu kapparatcha vehu omer lahem titbarchu min hashshamayim. veim ratza lenachem acherim hamemunne mematztzeo betoch haam veomer lahem tenuchamu: 
Vechen hammelech chayyav bechol divre avelut ella sheeno yotze mippetach palterin shello achar meto. veen tzarich lomar achar metim acherim. veeno menachem avelim. velo yatza david achar avner ella lehodia laam shello neherag birtzono: 
En adam nichnas lammelech lenachamo ella avadav umi shennatan lo reshut lehikkanes. veen lahen reshut ledabber lo divre tanchumin ella kefi ma sheyyarshe otam. ucheshemmavrin oto kol haam mesubbin al haaretz vehu mesev al haddargash:
Mishneh Torah, Mourning 8:
Avel chayyav likroa al meto shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 10 6)</small> "uvigdechem lo tifromu velo tamutu" ha acher chayyav lifrom. veen keria ella meummad. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 2 13 lo)</small> "vayyakam hammelech vayyikra et begadav". umehechan korea. millefanav. vehakkorea meacharav o min hatztzedadin o millematta lo yatza yede chovat keria. ella kohen gadol shehu porem millematta: 
Kamma shiur hakkera. tefach. veen tzarich lehavedil sefat habbeged. umuttar lo likroa bichli. veyesh lo likroa bifnim shello bifne adam. lefichach yesh lo lehachenis yado bifnim vekorea betzina. veeno chayyav likroa ella beged haelyon bilvad: 
Kol shivat yeme avelut hakkera lefanim veim ba lehachelif machlif veeno korea kera acher. shekkol kera sheeno bishat chimmum eno kera. bamme devarim amurim bishar hammetim chutz meaviv veimmo. aval al aviv veal immo korea ad shemmegalle et libbo. umavdil sefat habbeged veeno korea bichli ella beyado mibbachutz bifne kol haam vekorea kol habbegadim shealav. uveged hazzea haddavuk livsaro eno meakkev. veim hechlif beged acher chayyav likroa kol shiva. vechen al aviv veal immo choletz ketefo umotzi zeroo min hechaluk ad sheyyitgalle ketefo uzeroo. veholech kach lifne hammitta. veachar sheyyikkaver aviv veimmo eno chayyav lachlotz: 
Korin lekatan mippene agmat nefesh. vechole shemmet lo met en mekarin lo velo modiin lo shello tittaref alav dato. umeshattekin et hannashim mippanav: 
Vekorea adam al chamiv veal chamoto mippene kevod ishto. vechen haishsha koraat al chamiha veal chamotah mippene kevod balah: 
Mi sheen lo chaluk likroa venizdammen lo chaluk betoch shiva korea. leachar shiva eno korea. veal aviv veal immo afillu leachar shiva korea kol sheloshim yom. vechol hayyotze beveged karua lifne metim kelomar shehu kara atta alehen. hare ze gonev daat habberiyyot vezilzel bichvod hachayyim vehammetim: 
Haomer lachavero hasheileni chalukecha vaavakker et avi shehu chole vehalach umetzao shemmet. korea umeache umachazir lo et chaluko venoten lo deme kiro. veim lo hodio shehu mevakker lo chole hare ze lo yigga bo: 
Mi shehaya lo chole betoch beto venitallef vesavur shemmet vekara veachar kach met. im betoch kede dibbur eno chozer vekorea. veim leachar kede dibbur met chozer vekorea kera acher. vechen mi sheamru lo met aviv vekara veachar kach nimtza shemmet beno. amru lo met lo met vechassavur sheaviv vekara veachar kach nimtza beno. im toch kede dibbur noda lo amittat haddavar yatza yede keria veim leachar kede dibbur lo yatza vechayyav likroa kera acher: 
Mi shemmetu lo metim harebe keechad korea kera echad lechullam. haya bichlalan aviv o immo korea al kullan kera echad veal aviv veal immo kera acher: 
Mi shemmet lo met vekara alav veachar kach met lo met acher. im betoch shiva korea kera acher veim leachar shiva mosif al hakkera harishon kol shehu. met lo met shelishi achar shiva shel sheni mosif kol shehu vechen mosif veholech ad tabburo. higgia letabburo marchik shalosh etzbaot vekorea. nitmalle millefanav machziro laachorav. nitmalle millemala hofcho lematta. amru lo met aviv vekara veachar shiva met beno vehosif. mitache hattachton velo haelyon kemo sheyyitbaer. amru lo met beno vekara veachar shiva met aviv eno mosif ella korea kera acher. sheen aviv veimmo betosefet:
Mishneh Torah, Mourning 9:
Kol hakkeraim shekkorea adam al shear kerovav. sholel hakkera leachar shiva umeache leachar sheloshim. al aviv veal immo sholel leachar sheloshim veeno meache leolam. vehaishsha koraat vesholelet miyyad afillu al aviha veal immah mippene hatztzeniut: 
Kederech shekkorea adam al aviv veal immo kach chayyav likroa al rabbo shellimmedo tora. veal hannasi veal av bet din. veal rov hatztzibbur shenneherag. veal birkat hashshem. veal sefer tora shennisraf. veal are yehuda veal yerushalayim. veal hammikdash: 
Kol ellu hakkeraim korea ad shemmegalle et libbo veeno meache leolam. veaf al pi sheen mitachin muttar leshollan lemallan ulelakketan velaasotam kemin sullamot. velo asru ella beichuy alekkesanderi bilvad. vechol hakkorea mittoch hashshalal o hammelel o hallikkut lo asa kelum aval korea mittoch haichuy haalekkesanderi bilvad. afillu hafach hakkeli venaasa sefato lematta lo yeache: 
Ucheshem shehammocher asur leachoto kach hallokeach. lefichach hammocher tzarich lehodia lallokeach shekkera ze eno mitache: 
Uminnayin shekkorea al rabbo kederech shekkorea al aviv. shenneemar <small>(Melachim 2 2 12)</small> "vehu metzaek avi avi rechev yisrael ufarashav velo raahu od vayyachazek bivgadav vayyikraem lishnayim keraim". mikkan shechayyav lehavedil hassafa: 
Uminnayin shekkorin al hannasi veal av bet din veal shemua shebbaa shenneherag rov tzibbur. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 2 1 11)</small> "vayyachazek david bivgadav vayyikraem vegam kol haanashim asher itto" <small>(Shmuel 2 1 12)</small> "vayyispedu vayyivku vayyatzumu ad haarev". <small>(Shmuel 2 1 12)</small> "al shaul" ze nasi. <small>(Shmuel 2 1 12)</small> "veal yehonatan beno" ze av bet din. <small>(Shmuel 2 1 12)</small> "veal am Adonai veal bet yisrael ki naflu becharev" zo shemua raa: 
Uminnayin shekkorin al birkat hashshem. shenneemar <small>(Melachim 2 18 37)</small> "vayyavo elyakim ben chilkiyyahu asher al habbayit veshevna hassofer veyoach ben asaf hammazkir el chizkiyyahu kerue vegadim". echad hashshomea veechad hashshomea mippi shomea chayyavin likroa: 
Vehaedim en chayyavin likroa kesheyyaidu bevet din. shekkevar karu beshaa sheshshamu: 
Uminnayin shekkorin al sefer tora shennisraf. shenneemar <small>(yirmeya lo 23)</small> "vayhi kikro yehudi shalosh delatot vearbaa" vegomer <small>(yirmeya lo 23)</small> "ad tom kol hammegilla al haesh asher al haach" <small>(yirmeya lo kad)</small> "velo fachadu velo karu et bigdehem hammelech vechol avadav". michlal shechayyavin likroa. veen chayyavin likroa ella al sefer tora shennisraf bizroa kemaase shehaya. vechayyav likroa shete keriot achat al haggevil veachat al hakketav. shenneemar <small>(yirmeya lo 27)</small> "achare serof hammelech et hammegilla veet haddevarim": 
Uminnayin shekkorin al are yehuda veal yerushalayim veal hammikdash shecharvu. shenneemar <small>(yirmeya ma 5)</small> "vayyavou anashim mishshechem umishshilo umishshomron shemonim ish megulleche zakan ukerue vegadim": 
Kol mi sheamad im hammet bishat yetziat nishmato af al pi sheeno kerovo chayyav likroa vechen adam kasher shemmet hakkol chayyavin likroa alav af al pi sheeno chacham. vekorin tefach kishar haavelim. aval chacham shemmet hakkol kerovav vehakkol korin alav ad shemmegallin et libbam vecholtzin miyyamin. uvet midrasho shel oto chacham batel kol shiva. uchevar nahagu talmide chachamim bechol makom likroa ze al ze tefach. af al pi shehen shavin veen echad mehem melammed et chavero: 
Kol hakkorim al hechacham shemmet kevan shehechziru penehen meachore hammitta shollin. veyerae li shehakkorea al hechacham meache lemachar sheafillu rabbo shemmet en mitabbel alav ella yom echad bilvad o yom mita o yom shemua. ken yerae li shehakkorea al hannasi vechayyotze bo sholel lemachar af al pi sheeno meache alehem leolam: 
Chacham shebbaa shemuato shemmet en korin alav ella bishat hespedo vezehu kevodo. vesholel bo bayyom umeache lemachar: 
Av bet din shemmet hakkol korin alav vecholtzin missemol vechol batte midrashot shebbeiro betelin. uvene bet hakkeneset nichnasin levet hakkeneset. umeshannin et mekoman. hayyoshvin baddarom yeshvu batztzafon. vehayyoshvim batztzafon yeshvu baddarom: 
Nasi shemmet hakkol korin alav. vecholtzin shete hayyadayim mikkan umikkan. uvechol batte midrashot betelim. uvene bet hakkeneset nichnasin beshabbat levet hakkeneset vekorin shiva. velo yetayyelu bashshuk ella yoshvin mishpachot mishpachot davim kol hayyom:
Mishneh Torah, Mourning 10:
Hashshabbat ola leminyan avelut. veen avelut beshabbat ella bidvarim shebbetzina. kegon atifat harosh vetashmish hammitta urechitza bechammin. aval devarim shebbegaluy eno noheg bahen avelut. ella lovesh minalav vezokef et hammitta. venoten shalom lechol adam. veim yesh lo beged machlif. velo yilbash beged karua beshabbat. afillu al aviv veal immo. veim en lo lehachelif machzir et hakkera leacharav: 
Meematay zokfim et hammittot beerev shabbat. min hammincha ulemala. veaf al pi chen lo yeshev aleha ad shettecheshach. veaf al pi shello nishtayyer lo ella yom echad chozer vechofe otan bemotzae shabbat: 
Hargalim vechen rosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim en davar middivre avelut noheg bahen. vechol hakkover et meto afillu shaa achat kodem haregel o kodem rosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim batla mimmennu gezerat shiva. nimtza mone leachar rosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim shelosha veesrim yom uleachar happesach shishsha asar yom. shehare batla mimmennu gezerat shiva veshivat yeme hechag hare arbaa asar. vechen im kavar kodem atzeret mone achareha shishsha asar yom af al pi shehu yom echad hare hi regel veola leshiva yamim: 
Kavar et meto kodem chag hassukkot mone achar hechag tisha yamim bilvad. shehare shemini atzeret regel bifne atzmo venimtza yom tov harishon mafsik shiva. veshivat yeme hechag. ushemini shel chag regel echad hare echad veesrim yom: 
Hakkover et meto shivat yamim kodem regel min hargalim o kodem rosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim batla gezerat sheloshim. umuttar lesapper ulechabbes beerev yom tov o beerev yom hakkippurim shemmiktzat hayyom kechullo. veeno mone leacharehem kelum. veim al aviv veal immo hu mitabbel afillu metu kodem haregel sheloshim yom eno megalleach ad sheyyishlach pera. o ad sheyyigaru bo chaverav. veen hargalim mafsikin davar ze: 
Chal shishshi shello beerev haregel veen tzarich lomar chamishi o shelishi. eno megalleach velo batla mimmennu ella gezerat shiva bilvad. veeno muttar lirchotz velasuch velaasot davar ad sheyyikkanes yom tov. veyom tov mafsik shear hashshiva. uleachar yom tov mashlim kol sheloshim yom miyyom hammita veasur bahen bechol chamishsha devarim: 
Chal shevii shello lihyot beerev haregel vahare hu shabbat batla mimmennu gezerat sheloshim umuttar legalleach betoch hammoed shehare anus haya vei efshar lo legalleach beshabbat. vechen megalleach achar atzeret o achar rosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim shehare batla gezerat sheloshim veyesh lo legalleach bechol et sheyyirtze: 
Hakkover et meto betoch haregel lo chala alav avelut kelal. veeno noheg avelut baregel ella leachar haregel matchil limnot shiva venoheg bahen kol divre avelut. umone sheloshim miyyom hakkevura venoheg bishar hashsheloshim bechol gezerot sheloshim: 
Hammekomot sheosin shene yamim tovim mone hashshiva miyyom tov sheni haacharon. af al pi sheeno noheg avelut. hoil umiddivrehem hu ole lo min hamminyan. umone acharav shishsha yamim bilvad umone sheloshim yom miyyom hakkevura kemo sheamarnu: 
Hakkover et meto beyom tov sheni shehu yom tov haacharon. o beyom tov sheni shel atzeret. noheg bo avelut. hoil veyom tov sheni middivrehem vaavelut yom rishon shel tora yiddache ase shel divrehem mippene ase shel tora. aval im kavar beyom tov sheni shel rosh hashshana eno noheg bo avelut. sheshshenehen keyom aroch hen mittaam shebbearnu behilchot kiddush hachodesh:
Mishneh Torah, Mourning 11:
Af al pi sheen avelut bammoed korea al meto bammoed vecholetz ketefo. umavrin et haavelim lechem bammoed. kol ellu bechullo shel moed aval beyom tov afillu beyom tov sheni en korin velo choltzin velo mavrin: 
En korin bammoed velo choltzin ella hakkerovim shechayyavin baevel. o hakkorea vehacholetz al hechacham o al adam kasher. o mi shehaya omed bishat yetziat neshama. umavrin hakkol al hechacham bammoed letoch harchava kederech shemmavrin et haavelim. shehakkol avelim alav: 
Keshemmavrin et haavelim bammoed en mavrin ella al mittot zekufot. veen omrin birkat avelim bammoed. aval omdin beshura umenachamin ufotrin. veen mannichin et hammitta barchov shello leharegil et hahesped. shehammoed asur behesped uvetaanit. vechen en melakketim atzmot aviv veimmo bammoed sheevel hu lo. veen tzarich lomar shear kerovim. vechen en maspidin et hammet bachanukka uvefurim velo berashe chodashim aval nohagin bahen kol divre avelut. umuttar lispod lifne chanukka ufurim uleacharehen: 
Hannashim bammoed meannot aval lo metappechot. uverashe chodashim uvachanukka uvefurim meannot umetappechot aval en mekonnot lo baze velo baze. nikbar hammet lo meannot velo metappechot: 
E zehu innuy shekkullan onot keachat. kina sheachat omeret vechullan onot achareha. shenneemar <small>(yirmeya 9 19)</small> "velammedna venotechem nehi veishsha reutah kina". bamme devarim amurim bishar haam shemmetu. aval talmid chacham shemmet sofdim oto bammoed veen tzarich lomar bachanukka uvefurim verashe chodashim aval lo beyom tov sheni. veen sofdin oto beyamim ellu ella befanav. nikbar asurin behesped. veyom shemuato kivfanav hu vesofdin oto af al pi shehi rechoka: 
Lo teorer ishsha al met shellah sheloshim yom kodem lechag. kede shello yavo hechag vehem davim. sheen hammet mishtakkeach min hallev sheloshim yom. bamme devarim amurim bemet yashan. aval im met betoch sheloshim yom samuch lechag meoreret: 
Shivat yeme hachatnut hare hen keregel umi shemmet lo met betoch yeme hammishte afillu aviv veimmo mashlim shivat yeme hassimcha veachar kach noheg shivat yeme avelut. umone hashsheloshim meachar yeme hassimcha: 
Hechin kol tzarche hasseuda veafa pitto vetavach tivcho kede sheyyikkansu lassimcha umet lo met kodem sheyyikkansu lassimcha. im lo natan mayim al gabbe basar mocher habbasar vehappat venoheg shivat yeme avelut veachar kach noheg shivat yeme hammishte. veim natan mayim al gabbe basar shehare i efshar lemachro. machnisin et hammet lecheder veet hechatan veet hakkalla lachuppa. uvoel beilat mitzva uforesh venoheg shivat yeme hammishte veachar kach noheg shivat yeme avelut. vechol otan hayyamim noheg bidvarim shebbetzina keshabbat. lefichach hu yashen ben haanashim veishto yeshena ben hannashim kede shello yeshammesh mittato. veen monin tachshitin min hakkalla kol sheloshim yom. hayu bemakom sheefshar limkor habbasar af al pi shennatan alav mayim mocher venoheg avelut techilla. hayu bemakom shei efshar limkor habbasar af al pi shello natan alav mayim noheg shivat yeme hammishte techilla. bamme devarim amurim keshemmet aviv shel chatan o immah shel kalla. sheim yafsidu seuda zo en lahem mi sheyyitrach lahem. aval im met aviha shel kalla o immo shel chatan o shear kerovehem nohagin shivat yeme haevel techilla veachar kach tikkanes lachuppa veyinhagu shivat yeme hammishte:
Mishneh Torah, Mourning 12:
Hahesped kevod hammet hu. lefichach kofin et hayyorshin litten sechar mekonnim vehamekonnot vesofdin oto. veim tzivva shello yispeduhu en sofdin oto. aval im tzivva shello yikkaver en shomin lo. shehakkevura mitzva shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 23)</small> "ki kavor tikberennu": 
Kol hammitatztzel behespedo shel chacham eno maarich yamim. vechol hammitatztzel behesped adam kasher rauy likkaver bechayyav. vechol hammorid demaot al adam kasher hare secharo shamur al kach etzel hakkadosh baruch hu: 
En mannichin sefer tora al mittato shel chacham. veen meshannin oto mimmitta lemitta. veen motziin mittato ella derech petachim. lo sheyyeshalsheluha derech gaggot. uvishar haam muttar laasot: 
En pochatin mishshiva maamadot lemet. veen osin maamad umoshav befachot measara. veen osin ella bikrovim. veen osin ella beyom rishon uvevet hakkevarot uvemakom shennahagu. ketzad osin bemakom shennahagu. maamidin shear hakkerovim uvene mishpacha sheenan bene avel. veomrin lifnehem divre kinot vechayyotze bahen. veachar kach omer shevu yekarim shevu. veomer lifnehem devarim acherim keshehen yoshvin veachar kach imdu yekarim amodu. veomer keshehen omdin vechozer veomer kach [ad] sheva peamim: 
Kederech sheosin maamad umoshav laanashim bemakom shennahagu. kach osin lenashim. umaspidin hannashim kaanashim bechol makom. aval en mannichin mittat haishsha barchov leolam shezze genay laishsha. ella samuch lemitatah kevuratah: 
Hamelakket atzamot en omrim alehem kinim unehi. velo birkat avelim velo tanchume avelim. aval omrim alehen divre shevach lehakkadosh baruch hu vedivre kibbushim: 
Hamefanne arono shel met mimmakom lemakom. im shidro kayyemet omdin alav beshura. veomrim alav birkat avelim vetanchume avelim. umaspidin oto af al pi sheheeviruhu leachar shenem asar chodesh. veim en shidro kayyemet en maspidin oto. veen omdin alav beshura veen omrin alav birkat avelim velo tanchume avelim. veellu hen birkat avelim devarim sheomrim bevet haavel. tanchume avelim sheomrim bashshura: 
Hamelakket atzmot aviv veimmo hare ze mitabbel alehen kol hayyom kullo. velaerev en mitabbel afillu tzerurin lo bisdino. veen omrin alehen kinot: 
En maspidin et hakketannim. uven kamma shanim yihye rauy lehesped. bene aniyyim o bene zekenim bene chamesh. uvene ashirim bene shesh. echad zecharim veechad nekevot: 
Tinok shemmet kol sheloshim yotze bechek venikbar beishsha achat uvishne anashim. aval lo beish echad uvishte nashim mippene hayyichud. veen omdin alav beshura. veen omrin alav birkat avelim vetanchume avelim. ben sheloshim yom gemurim yotze biglusekma ketanna hannittelet baagappayim. veomdin alav beshura. veomrin alav birkat avelim vetanchume avelim. ben shenem asar chodesh yotze bemitta: 
Kol hayyotze bemitta rabbim matzhivin alav. vechol sheeno yotze bemitta en rabbim matzhivin alav. vkol hannikkar larabbim rabbim mitassekin bo. vechol sheeno nikkar larabbim en rabbim chayyavin lehitassek bo. umakom shennahagu nashim latzet lifne hammitta yotzot lifne hammitta. leachar hammitta yotzot leachar hammitta: 
Haavadim vehashshefachot en maspidin otan veen omdin alehen beshura. veen omrim alehen birkat avelim vetanchume avelim. ella omrin lo keshem sheomrin lo al shoro veal chamoro hammakom yemalle chesroncha:
Mishneh Torah, Mourning 13: Ketzad menachamin et haavelim. achar shekkovrin et hammet mitkabbetzin haavelim veomdin betzad bet hakkevarot. vechol hamelavvin et hammet omdin saviv lahen shura lifne shura. veen shura pechuta measara veen avelim min hamminyan:

Haavelim omdin lismol hamenachamin vechol hamenachamin bain etzel haavelim echad echad. veomrim lahen tenuchamu min hashshamayim. veachar kach holech haavel leveto. vechol yom veyom mishshivat yeme avelut bain bene adam lenachamo. ben shebbau panim chadashot ben shello bau:

Haavel mesev barosh. veen hamenachamin rashshain leshev ella al gabbe karka. shenneemar <small>(Iyov 2 13)</small> "vayyeshvu itto laaretz". veen rashshain lomar davar ad sheyyiftach haavel et piv techilla. shenneemar <small>(Iyov 2 13)</small> "veen dover elav davar" uchetiv <small>(Iyov 3 1)</small> "achare chen patach iyyov et pihu" vegomer <small>(Iyov 4 1)</small> "vayyaan elifaz". vechevan shenninea berosho shuv en hamenachamin rashshain leshev etzlo. shello yatrichuhu yoter midday:

Met sheen lo avelim lehitnachem. baim asara bene adam kesherin veyoshvin bimkomo kol shivat yeme haavelut. ushear haam mitkabbetzin alehen. veim lo hayu sham asara kevuin bechol yom veyom mitkabbetzin asara mishshear haam veyoshvin bimkomo:
Hakkol chayyavin laamod bifne nasi chutz meavel vechole. ulechol haomed mippanav omer lo shev chutz meavel vechole shemmashma yeshev beevlo yeshev bechalyo:
Mechabbedin umerabbetzin bevet haavel. umedichin kearot vechosot vekitonot utzelochiyyot umadlikin et hannerot. aval en meviin sham lo et hammugmar velo et habbesamim:

En molichin levet haavel hammaachol shemmavrin bo. lo bichle kesef velo bichle shaam vechayyotze bahen. ella bichle nesarim shel arava kelufa vechayyotze bahen. shello levayyesh et mi sheen lo. veen mashkin bizchuchit levana ella bitzvua. shello levayyesh et haaniyyim sheen yenotehen tovot:
En shotin bevet haavel yeter al asara kosot lechol echad veechad. shelosha kodem achila. ushelosha betoch achila. vearbaa leachar achila. velo yosif shemma yishtakker:
En omrin shemua vehaggada bevet haavel ella yoshvin davin. vechen en omrin bifne hammet ella devarim shel met. aval laasok bedivre tora befanav o bevet hakkevarot asur:

En bochin al hammet yeter mishshelosha yamim. veen maspidin yeter mishshiva. bamme devarim amurim bishar haam. aval talmide chachamim hakkol lefi chachmatan. veen bochiyin alehem yoter mishsheloshim yom. sheen lanu gadol mimmoshe rabbenu uchetiv <small>(Devarim 34 8)</small> "vayyittemu yeme vechi evel mshe". vechen en maspidin yeter al shenem asar chodesh. en lanu bechachma gadol merabbenu hakkadosh ushenem asar chodesh bilvad nispad. vechen chacham shebbaa shemuato leachar shenem asar chodesh en sofdin oto:

Al yitkashshe adam al meto yeter midday. shenneemar <small>(yirmeya 22 10)</small> "al tivku lemet veal tanudu lo". kelomar yeter midday shezzehu minhago shel olam. vehametzaer [atzmo yoter] al minhago shel olam hare ze tippesh. ella ketzad yaase. shelosha livchi. shiva lehesped. sheloshim yom letisporet velishar hachamishsha devarim:

Kol mi sheeno mitabbel kemo shetztziuu chachamim hare ze achzari. ella yifchad veyidag vifashpesh bemaasav veyachzor bitshuva. veechad mibbene chavura shemmet tidag kol hachavura kullah. kol shelosha yamim harishonim yire et atzmo keillu cherev munnachat lo al tzavvaro. umishshelosha vead shiva [keillu hi] munnachat bekeren zavit. mikkan veelach [keillu] overet kenegdo bashshuk. kol ze lehachin atzmo veyachzor veyeor mishshenato. vahare hu omer hikkita otam velo chalu michlal shetztzarich lehakitz velachul:
Mishneh Torah, Mourning 14:
Mitzvat ase shel divrehem levakker cholim. ulenachem avelim. ulehotzi hammet. ulehachnis hakkalla. ulelauot haorchim. ulehitassek bechol tzarche hakkevura. laset al hakkatef. velelech lefanav velispod velachpor velikbor. vechen lesammeach hakkalla vehechatan. ulesaadam bechol tzarchehem. veellu hen gemilut chasadim shebbegufo sheen lahem shiur. af al pi shekkol mitzvot ellu middivrehem hare hen bichlal <small>(Vayikra 19 18)</small> "veahavta lereacha kamocha". kol haddevarim sheatta rotze sheyyaasu otam lecha acherim. ase atta otan leachich betora uvemitzvot: 
Sechar hallevaya merubbe min hakkol. vehu hachok shechakako avraham avinu vederech hachesed shennahag bah. maachil ovre derachim umashke otan umelavve otan. ugedola hachenasat orchim mehakebalat pene shechina. shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 18 2)</small> "vayyar vehinne shelosha anashim". veliuuyam yoter mehachenasatan. amru chachamim kol sheeno melavve keillu shofech damim: 
Kofin lilvaya kederech shekkofin litzdaka. uvet din hayu metakkenin sheluchin lelauot adam haover mimmakom lemakom. veim nitatztzelu bedavar ze maale alehem keillu shafchu damim. afillu hamelavve et chavero arba ammot yesh lo sachar harebe. vechamma shiur levaya shechayyav adam bah. harav letalmid ad ibburah shel ir. vehaish lachavero ad techum shabbat. vehattalmid larav ad parsa. veim haya rabbo muvhak ad shalosh parsaot: 
Bikkur cholim mitzva al hakkol. afillu gadol mevakker et hakkatan. umevakkerin harebe peamim bayyom. vechol hammosif meshubbach uvilvad shello yatriach. vechol hamevakker et hachole keillu natal chelek mechalyo vehekel mealav. vechol sheeno mevakker keillu shofech damim: 
En mevakkerin et hachole ella miyyom shelishi vahala. veim kafatz alav hacholi vehichbid mevakkerin oto miyyad. veen mevakkerin et hachole lo beshalosh shaot rishonot bayyom. velo beshalosh acharonot. mippene shehen mitassekin betzarche hachole. veen mevakkerin lo chole meayim velo chole haayin. velo mechoshe harosh. mippene shehabbikkur kashe lahen: 
Hannichnas levakker et hachole lo yeshev lo al gabbe mitta velo al gabbe kisse velo al gabbe safsal velo al gabbe makom gavoah velo lemala mimmeraashotav. ella mitattef veyoshev lematta mimmeraashotav umevakkesh alav rachamim veyotze: 
Yerae li shennechamat avelim kodem levikkur cholim. shennichum avelim gemilut chesed im hachayyim veim hammetim: 
Mi shehaya lefanav met vechalla. meniach et hakkalla umitassek im hammet. vechen hu omer <small>(Kohelet 7 4)</small> "lev chachamim bevet evel" vegomer. met vechalla sheppagu ze baze badderech. maavirin et hammet millifne hakkalla. veze veze ovrin millifne hammelech: 
Mevattelin talmud tora lehotzaat hammet ulehachnasat hakkalla. bamme devarim amurim besheen lo kol tzarko. aval yesh lo kol tzarko en mevattelin. vechol sheen mitassekin battora chayyavin lehitassek immo: 
Met echad bair. kol bene hair asurin baasiyyat melacha ad sheyyikberuhu. veim yesh lo mi sheyyitassek bitzrachav muttarin: 
Talmid chacham shemmet. afillu hayu immo ad shishshim ribbo mevattelin talmud tora lehotzaato. hayu shishshim ribbo en mevattelin. veim haya melammed laacherim en lo shiur ella mevattelin hakkol lehotzaato: 
Kovrin mete akkum umenachamin avelehem umevakkerin cholehem mippene darche shalom: 
Batte hakkevarot asurin bahanaa. ketzad. en ochlin bahen. veen shotin bahen. veen osin bahen melacha. velo korin bahen velo shonin bahen. kelalo shel davar en neotin bahen. velo nohagin bahen kallut rosh. lo yelech adam betoch arba ammot shel kever utefillin beyado vesefer tora bizroo. velo yitpallel sham. uverichuk arba ammot muttar: 
Hammolich atzamot mimmakom lemakom lo yittenem bediskiyya veyannichem al gabbe chamoro veyirkav alehem. mippene shennoheg bahen minhag bizzayon. veim haya mityare mippene haggannavim umippene hallistim muttar: 
En mefannin et hammet mikkever lekever afillu mibbazuy limchubbad. veim haya betoch sadehu mefannehu afillu mimmechubbad levazuy: 
En kovrin met al gabbe met velo shene metim keechad shebbizzayon hu. vekatan hayyashen im immo nikbar immah: 
Afar hakkever eno asur bahanaa sheen karka olam neeseret. aval kever habbinyan asur bahanaa: 
Habbone kever lemet lo neesar ad sheyyikkanes bo hammet. vaafillu hetil bo nefel neesar bahanaa: 
Nefesh shennaasa leshem chay vesam bo hammet. vehosif bo dimos acher leshem hammet. af al pi sheppinna hammet hakkol asur bahanaa. veim hikkir et hattosefet choletz otah vehashshear muttar. naasa leshem hammet kevan shehuttal bo hammet neesar af al pi sheppinnahu: 
Habbone kever leaviv vehalach ukevaro bekever acher. hare ze lo yikkaver bo met acher olamit. vehakkever hazze asur bahanaa mippene kevod aviv: 
Hammet asur bahanaa kullo. chutz missearo shehu muttar bahanaa mippene sheeno gufo. vechen arono vechol tachrichav asurin bahanaa. aval kelim hammuchanim letachrich lo neesru bahanaa. afillu arag beged lemet lo neesar ad sheyyaggia bammitta hannikberet immo. sheen hahazmana oseret: 
Kol hakkelim shezzorkin al hammet al hammitta hannikberet immo asurin bahanaa. shello yitchallefu battachrichin: 
Hayu aviv veimmo mezarkin kelim bachamatan al hammet. mitzva al acherim lehatztzilan. veim higgiu lammitta hannikberet immo en matztzilin otan: 
Melammedin et haadam shello yehe chabbelan velo yafsid et hakkelim veyashlichem lechabbala. mutav letittam laaniyyim veal yashlichem lerimma vetolea. vechol hammarbe kelim al hammet over belo tashchit: 
Melech shemmet okrin sus shehaya rochev alav. veegla shehayta moshechet bakkaron shehaya yoshev bo menashsher parsoteha min haarkubba ulematta makom sheen ose otah terefa. umoshivin yeshiva al kivro shiva yamim. shenneemar <small>(divrei hayamim 2 32 33)</small> "vechavod asu lo vemoto" ze shehoshivu lo yeshiva al kivro. venasi shemmet en mevattelin yeshivato yeter al sheloshim yom: 
Melech o nasi shemmet yesh lahen lisrof mittato vechol kele tashmisho. veen baze derech haemori. velo mishshum hashechata. shenneemar <small>(yirmeya lod 5)</small> "beshalom tamut uvemisrefot avotecha harishonim" <small>(yirmeya lod 5)</small> "yisrefu lach": seliku lehu hilchot avel besad
Mishneh Torah, Kings and Wars 1:
Shalosh mitzvot nitztauu yisrael bishat kenisatan laaretz. lemannot lahem melech shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 15)</small> "som tasim alecha melech". ulehachrit zaro shel amalek shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 19)</small> "timche et zecher amalek". velivnot bet habbechira shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 5)</small> "leshichno tidreshu uvata shamma": 
Minnuy melech kodem lemilchemet amalek. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 15 1)</small> "oti shalach Adonai limshochocha lemelech" <small>(Shmuel 1 15 3)</small> "atta lech vehikkita et amalek". vehacheratat zera amalek kodemet levinyan habbayit. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 2 7 1)</small> "vayhi ki yashav hammelech beveto vaAdonai heniach lo missaviv mikkol oyvav" <small>(Shmuel 2 7 2)</small> "vayyomer hammelech el natan hannavi anochi yoshev bevet arazim" vegomer. meachar shehakamat melech mitzva lamma lo ratza hakkadosh baruch hu kesheshshaalu melech mishshemuel. lefi sheshshaalu betaromet. velo shaalu lekayyem hammitzva ella mippene shekkatzu bishmuel hannavi. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 8 7)</small> "ki lo otcha maasu ki oti maasu" vegomer: 
En maamidin melech battechilla ella al pi bet din shel shivim zekenim veal pi navi. kihoshua shemminnahu moshe rabbenu uvet dino. ucheshaul vedavid shemminnam shemuel haramati uvet dino: 
En maamidin melech mikkehal gerim afillu achar kamma dorot ad shettihye immo miyyisrael. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 15)</small> "lo tuchal latet alecha ish nachri asher lo achicha hu". velo lemalchut bilvad ella lechol serarot shebbeyisrael. lo sar tzava velo sar chamishshim o sar asara. afillu memunne al ammat hammayim shemmechallek mimmenna lassadot. veen tzarich lomar dayyan o nasi shello yehe ella miyyisrael. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 15)</small> "mikkerev achecha tasim alecha melech" kol mesimot sheatta mesim lo yehu ella mikkerev achecha: 
En maamidin ishsha bemalchut shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 15)</small> "alecha melech" velo malka. vechen kol mesimot shebbeyisrael en memannim bahem ella ish: 
Veen maamidin melech velo kohen gadol. lo katztzav. velo sappar. velo ballan [1.] velo bursi. lo mippene shehen pesulin ella hoil veummanutan nikla haam mezalzelin bahen leolam. umishsheyyaase bimlacha meellu yom echad nifsal: 
Keshemmaamidin hammelech moshchin oto beshemen hammishcha. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 10 1)</small> "vayyikkach shemuel et pach hashshemen vayyitzok al rosho vayyishshakehu". umeachar shemmoshchin hammelech hare ze zoche lo ulevanav ad olam. shehammalchut yerushsha shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 20)</small> "lemaan yaarich yamim al mamlachto hu uvanav bekerev yisrael". heniach ben katan meshammerin lo hammelucha ad sheyyagdil. kemo sheasa yehoyada leyoash. vechol hakkodem benachala kodem lirushshat hammelucha. vehabben haggadol kodem lekatan mimmennu. velo hammalchut bilvad ella kol hasserarot vechol hamminnuyin shebbeyisrael yerushsha livno uleven beno ad olam. vehu sheyyihye habben memalle mekom avotav bechachma uveyira. haya memalle beyira af al pi sheeno memalle bechachma maamidin oto bimkom aviv umelammedin oto. vechol mi sheen bo yirat shamayim af al pi shechachmato merubba en memannin oto leminnuy min hamminnuyin shebbeyisrael. kevan shennimshach david zacha becheter malchut. vahare hammalchut lo ulevanav hazzecharim ad olam. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 2 7 16)</small> "kisacha yihye nachon ad olam". velo zacha ella lichsherim shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 132 12)</small> "im yishmeru vanecha beriti". af al pi shello zacha ella lichsherim lo tikkaret hammelucha mizzera david leolam. hakkadosh baruch hu hivticho bechach shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 89 lo)</small> "im yaazvu vanav torati uvemishpatay lo yelechun" <small>(Tehillim 89 33)</small> "ufakadti veshevet pisham uvingaim avonam" <small>(Tehillim 89 34)</small> "vechasdi lo afir meimmo": 
Navi sheheemid melech mishshear shivte yisrael. vehaya oto hammelech holech bederech hattora vehammitzva venilcham milchamot Adonai. hare ze melech vechol mitzvot hammalchut nohagot bo. af al pi sheikkar hammalchut ledavid. veyihye mibbanav melech. shehare achiyya hashshiloni heemid yaravam veamar lo <small>(Melachim 1 11 38)</small> "vehaya im shamoa tishma et kol asher atzavvecha uvaniti lecha vayit neeman kaasher baniti ledavid" vegomer. veamar lo achiyya <small>(Melachim 1 11 36)</small> "velivno etten shevet echad lemaan heyot nir ledavid avdi kol hayyamim lefanay birushalami": 
Malche bet david hem haomdim leolam shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 2 7 16)</small> "kisacha yihye nachon ad olam". aval im yaamod melech mishshear yisrael tippasek hammalchut mibbeto. shehare neemar leyaravam <small>(Melachim 1 11 39)</small> "ach lo chol hayyamim": 
En moshchin malche yisrael beshemen hammishcha ella beshemen afarsemon. veen memannin otan birushalayim leolam ella melech yisrael mizzera david. veen moshchin ella zera david: 
Keshemmoshchin malche bet david en moshchin otan ella al hammayan: 
Veen moshchin melech ben melech. ella im ken hayta sham machloket o milchama moshchin oto kede lesallek hammachaloket. lefichach mashchu shelomo mippene adoniyya. veyoash mippene atalya. umashchu yehoachaz mippene yehoyakim achiv:
Mishneh Torah, Kings and Wars 2:
Kavod gadol nohagin bammelech. umesimin lo ema veyira belev kol adam. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 15)</small> "som tasim" shettehe emato alecha. en rochvin al suso. veen yoshvin al kiso. veen mishtammeshin besharvito. velo bechitro. velo beechad mikkol kele tashmishav. ucheshehu met kullan nisrafin lefanav. vechen lo yishtammesh baavadav veshifchotav veshammashav ella melech acher. lefichach avishag hayta mutteret lishlomo vaasura laadoniyya: 
Aval ishto shel melech enah nivelet leacher leolam. afillu hammelech eno nose almanato o gerushato shel melech acher: 
Veasur liroto keshehu erom velo keshehu mistapper. velo keshehu bevet hammerchatz. velo keshehu mistappeg. veeno choletz shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 9)</small> "veyarka befanav" veze bizzayon. vaafillu ratza en shomin lo. shehammelech shemmachal al kevodo en kevodo machul. vehoil veeno choletz eno meyabbem. vechen [im met hu] kevan shei efshar leyabbem et ishto kach en choltzin lah ella teshev leolam bezikkatah: 
Met lo met eno yotze mippetach palterin shello. ucheshemmavrin oto kol haam mesubbin al haaretz vehu mesev al haddargash. veim nichnas laazara vehaya mizzera david yeshev. sheen yeshiva baazara ella lemalche bet david bilvad. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 2 7 18)</small> "vayyavo hammelech david vayyeshev lifne Adonai": 
Hammelech mistapper bechol yom. umetakken atzmo umitnae bemalbushin naim umefoarim. shenneemar <small>(yeshaya log 17)</small> "melech beyafyo techezena enecha". veyoshev al kisse malchuto bappalterin shello. umesim keter berosho. vechol haam bain elav beet sheyyirtze. veomdin lefanav umishtachavim artza. afillu navi omed lifne hammelech mishtachave artza. shenneemar <small>(Melachim 1 1 23)</small> "hinne natan hannavi vayyavo lifne hammelech vayyishtachu lammelech". aval kohen gadol eno ba lifne hammelech ella im ratza. veeno omed lefanav ella hammelech omed lifne kohen gadol. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 27 21)</small> "velifne elazar hakkohen yaamod". af al pi chen mitzva al kohen gadol lechabbed et hammelech ulehoshivo velaamod mippanav kesheyyavo lo. velo yaamod hammelech lefanav ella kesheyyishal lo bemishpat haurim. vechen mitzva al hammelech lechabbed lomde hattora. uchesheyyikkansu lefanav sanhedrin vechachme yisrael yaamod lifnehem veyoshivem betziddo. vechen haya yehoshafat melech yehuda ose afillu letalmid chacham haya omed mikkiso umenashsheko vekore lo rabbi umori. bamme devarim amurim bizman sheyyihye hammelech beveto levaddo hu vaavadav yaase ze betzina. aval befarhesya bifne haam lo yaase. velo yaamod mippene adam. velo yedabber rakkot. velo yikra leadam ella bishmo kede shettehe yirato belev hakkol: 
Kederech shechalak lo hakkatuv hakkavod haggadol. vechiyyev hakkol bichvodo. kach tzivvahu lihyot libbo bekirbo shafal vechalal shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 109 22)</small> "velibbi chalal bekirbi". velo yinhag gassut lev beyisrael yeter midday shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 20)</small> "levilti rum levavo meechav". veyihye chonen umerachem liktannim ugedolim. veyetze veyavo becheftzehem uvetovatam. veyachus al kevod katan shebbakketannim. ucheshemmedabber el kol hakkahal bilshon rabbim yedabber rakkot. shenneemar <small>(divrei hayamim 1 28 2)</small> "shemauni achay veammi". veomer <small>(Melachim 1 12 7)</small> "im hayyom tihye eved laam hazze" vegomer. leolam yitnaheg baanava yetera. en lanu gadol mimmoshe rabbenu vehu omer <small>(Shemot 16 8)</small> "venachnu ma lo alenu telunnotechem". veyisbol tarcham umassaam utelunotam vekitzpam kaasher yissa haomen et hayyonek. roe kerao hakkatuv. lirot beyaakov ammo. vedarko shel roe meforash bekabbala keroe edro yire bizroo yekabbetz telaim uvecheko yissa vegomer:
Mishneh Torah, Kings and Wars 3:
Beet sheyyeshev hammelech al kisse malchuto kotev lo sefer tora leatzmo yeter al hassefer shehinnichu lo avotav. umaggiho missefer haazara al pi bet din shel shivim veechad. im lo hinnichu lo avotav o shenneevad kotev shene sifre tora. echad mannicho bevet genazav shehu metzuvve bo kechol echad miyyisrael. vehashsheni lo yazuz millefanav ella beet sheyyikkanes levet hakkisse. o levet hammerchatz. o lemakom sheen rauy likria. yotze lammilchama vehu immo. nichnas vehu immo. yoshev baddin vehu immo. mesev vehu kenegdo shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 19)</small> "vehayta immo vekara vo kol yeme chayyav": 
Lo yarbe lo nashim. mippi hashshemua lamdu shehu lokeach ad shemone esre nashim ben hannashim ufillagshim hakkol shemone esre. veim hosif achat uvealah loke. veyesh lo legaresh velissa acheret tachat zo sheggeresh: 
Velo yarbe lo susim ella kede merkavto. afillu sus echad panuy lihyot ratz lefanav kederech sheosin shear hammelachim asur. veim hosif loke: 
Velo yarbe lo kesef vezahav lehanniach bignazav ulehitgaot bo o lehitnaot bo. ella kede sheyyitten lechelotav velaavadav uleshammashav. vechol kesef vezahav sheyyarbe leotzar bet Adonai velihyot sham muchan letzarche hatztzibbur ulemilchamotam hare ze mitzva lehareboto. veen asur ella leharebot leatzmo bevet genazav shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 17)</small> "velo yarbe lo". veim hirba loke: 
Hammelech asur lishtot derech shichrut. shenneemar <small>(Mishlei lo 4)</small> "al lamlachim sheto yayin". ella yihye osek battora uvetzarche yisrael bayyom uvallayla. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 19)</small> "vehayta immo vekara vo kol yeme chayyav": 
Vechen lo yihye shatuf benashim. afillu lo hayta lo ella achat lo yihye matzuy etzlah tamid kishar hattippeshim. shenneemar <small>(Mishlei lo 3)</small> "al titten lannashim chelecha". al hasarat libbo hikpida tora shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 17)</small> "velo yasur levavo". shellibbo hu lev kol kehal yisrael lefichach dibbeko hakkatuv battora yeter mishshear haam shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 19)</small> "kol yeme chayyav": 
Kevar bearnu shemmalche bet david danin otan umeidin alehen. aval malche yisrael gazru chachamim shello yadun velo danin oto. velo meid velo meidin alav. mippene shellibban gas bahen veyavo min haddavar takkala vehefsed al haddat: 
Kol hammored bemelech yisrael yesh lammelech reshut lehargo. afillu gazar al echad mishshear haam sheyyelech lemakom peloni velo halach o shello yatza mibbeto veyatza chayyav mita. veim ratza lehargo yehareg. shenneemar <small>(Yehoshua 1 18)</small> "kol ish asher yamre et picha". vechen kol hamevazze et hammelech o hamecharfo yesh lammelech reshut lehargo. keshimi ben gera. veen lammelech reshut laharog ella besayif bilvad. veyesh lo leesor ulehakkot beshotin lichvodo. aval lo yafkir mamon veim hifkir hare ze gezel: 
Hamevattel gezerat hammelech bishvil shennitassek bemitzvot. afillu bemitzva kalla hare ze patur. divre harav vedivre haeved divre harav kodmin. veen tzarich lomar im gazar hammelech levattel mitzva sheen shomin lo: 
Kol hahoreg nefashot shello biraya berura. o belo hateraa. afillu beed echad. o sone sheharag bishgaga. yesh lammelech reshut lehargo uletakken haolam kefi ma shehashshaa tzericha. vehoreg rabbim beyom echad vetole umannichan teluyim yamim rabbim lehatil ema uleshabber yad rishe haolam:
Mishneh Torah, Kings and Wars 4:
Reshut yesh lammelech litten mas al haam litzrachav o letzorech hammilchamot. vekotzev lo meches veasur lehaveriach min hammeches. sheyyesh lo ligzor shekkol mi sheyyignov hammeches yillakach mamono o yehareg shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 8 17)</small> "veattem tihyu lo laavadim". ulehallan hu omer <small>(Devarim 20 11)</small> "yihyu lecha lamas vaavaducha". mikkan shennoten mas vekotzev meches vedinav bechol ellu haddevarim vechayyotze bahen din. shekkol haamur befarashat melech melech zoche bo: 
Vesholeach bechol gevul yisrael velokeach min haam haggibborim veanshe chayil veose mehen chayil lemerkavto uvefarashav umaamid mehen omdim lefanav. umaamid mehen anashim larutz lefanav. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 8 11)</small> "vesam lo bemerkavto ufarashav veratzu lifne merkavto". velokeach min hayyafim shebbahem lihyot shammashim veomdim lefanav shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 8 16)</small> "veet bachurechem hattovim" <small>(Shmuel 1 8 16)</small> "yikkach veasa limlachto": 
Vechen lokeach min baale haummanuyyot kol ma shehu tzarich veosin lo melachto venoten secharan. velokeach kol habbehemot vehaavadim vehashshefachot limlachto venoten secharan o demehen. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 8 12)</small> "velacharsh charisho veliktzor ketziro velaasot kele milchamto uchele richbo". <small>(Shmuel 1 8 16)</small> "veet avdechem veet shifchotechem veet bachurechem hattovim veet chamorechem yikkach veasa limlachto": 
Vechen lokeach mikkol gevul yisrael nashim ufilagshim. nashim bichtubba vekiddushin. ufilagshim belo ketubba uvelo kiddushin. ella beyichud bilvad kone otah umutteret lo. aval hahedyot asur befilegesh ella beama haivriyya bilvad achar yiud. veyesh lo [reshut] laasot happilagshim shellokeach learmono tabbachot veofot verakkachot. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 8 13)</small> "veet benotechem yikkach lerakkachot uletabbachot uleofot": 
Vechen kofe et haruyin lihyot sarim umemanne otam sare alafim vesare chamishshim. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 8 12)</small> "velasum lo sare alafim vesare chamishshim": 
Velokeach hassadot vehazzetim vehakkeramim laavadav kesheyyelchu lammilchama veyifshetu al mekomot ellu im en lahem ma yochlu ella mishsham. venoten demehen. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 8 14)</small> "veet sedotechem veet karmechem vezetechem hattovim yikkach venatan laavadav": 
Veyesh lo maaser min hazzeraim umin hailanot umin habbehema. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 8 15)</small> "vezarechem vecharmechem yasor" vegomer. <small>(Shmuel 1 8 17)</small> "tzonchem yasor": 
Hammelech hammashiach notel mikkol haaratzot shekkovshin yisrael chelek echad mishshelosha asar. vedavar ze chok lo ulevanav ad olam: 
Kol haruge hammelech mamonan lammelech. vechol hammamlachot shekkovesh hare otzrot hammelachim lammelech. ushear habbizza shebbozzin bozzin venotnin lefanav vehu notel mechetza barosh. umachatzit habbizza cholkin otah kol anshe hatztzava beyachad im haam hayyoshvin al hakkelim bammachane leshamram cholkin beshave. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 30 24)</small> "ki kechelek hayyored bammilchama uchechelek hayyshev al hakkelim yachdav yachaloku": 
Kol haaretz shekkovesh hare hi shello venoten laavadav uleanshe hammilchama kefi ma sheyyirtze. umanniach leatzmo kefi ma sheyyirtze. uvechol ellu haddevarim dino din. uvechol yihyu maasav leshem shamayim. vetihye megammato umachshavto leharim dat haemet. ulemalleot haolam tzedek. velishbor zeroa harshaim ulehillachem milchamot Adonai. sheen mamlichin melech techilla ella laasot mishpat umilchamot. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 8 20)</small> "ushefatanu malkenu veyatza lefanenu venilcham et milchamotenu":
Mishneh Torah, Kings and Wars 5:
En hammelech nilcham techilla ella milchemet mitzva. vee zo hi milchemet mitzva zo milchemet shiva amamim. umilchemet amalek. veezrat yisrael miyyad tzar shebba alehem. veachar kach nilcham bemilchemet harshut vehi hammilchama shennilcham im shear haammim kede leharechiv gevul yisrael uleharbot bigdullato veshimo: 
Milchemet mitzva eno tzarich littol bah reshut bet din. ella yotze meatzmo bechol et. vechofe haam latzet. aval milchemet harshut eno motzi haam bah ella al pi bet din shel shivim veechad: 
Uforetz laasot lo derech veen memachin beyado. vederech hammelech en lah shiur. ella kefi ma shehu tzarich. eno meakkem hadderachim mippene karmo shel ze o mippene sadehu shel ze. ella holech beshave veose milchamto: 
Mitzvat ase lehacharim shiva amamin shenneemar <small>(Devarim 20 17)</small> "hacharem tacharimem". vechol shebba leyado echad mehen velo harago over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 20 16)</small> "lo techayye kol neshama". uchevar avad zichram: 
Vechen mitzvat ase leabbed zecher amalek. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 19)</small> "timche et zecher amalek". umitzvat ase lizkor tamid maasav haraim vaarivato. kede leorer evato. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 17)</small> "zachor et asher asa lecha amalek". mippi hashshemua lamdu zachor bappe lo tishkach ballev. sheasur lishkoach evato vesinato: 
Kol haaratzot shekkovshin yisrael bemelech al pi bet din. hare ze kibbush rabbim vahare hi keeretz yisrael shekkavash yehoshua lechol davar. vehu shekkavshu achar kibbush kol eretz yisrael haamura battora: 
Umuttar lishkon bechol haolam chutz meeretz mitzrayim. min hayyam haggadol vead hammaarav arba meot parsa al arba meot parsa keneged eretz kush ucheneged hammidbar. hakkol asur lehityashshev bah. bishlosha mekomot hizhira tora shello lashuv lemitzrayim. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 16)</small> "lo tosifun lashuv badderech hazze od". <small>(Devarim 28 68)</small> "lo tosif od lirotah". <small>(Shemot 14 13)</small> "lo tosifu lirotam od ad olam". vaalekkesanderia bichlal haissur: 
Muttar lachzor leeretz mitzrayim lischora velifrakmatya. velichbosh aratzot acherot. veen asur ella lehishtakea sham. veen lokin al lav ze. shebbeet hakkenisa muttar hu. veim yachashov leshev ulehishtakea sham en bo maase. veyerae li sheim kavash eretz mitzrayim melech yisrael al pi bet din shehi mutteret. velo hizhira ella lashuv lah yechidim o lishkon bah vehi beyad akkum mippene shemmaaseha mekulkalin yoter mikkol haaratzot. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 18 3)</small> "kemaase eretz mitzrayim": 
Asur latzet meeretz yisrael lechutza laaretz leolam. ella lilmod tora o lissa ishsha o lehatztzil min haakkum. veyachzor laaretz. vechen yotze hu lischora. aval lishkon bechutza laaretz asur ella im ken chazak sham haraav ad shennaasa sheve dinar chittin bishne dinarin. bamme devarim amurim keshehayu hammaot metzuyot vehapperot beyoker. aval im happerot bezol velo yimtza maot velo bema yistakker veavda peruta min hakkis. yetze lechol makom sheyyimtza bo revach. veaf al pi shemmuttar latzet enah middat chasidut shehare machlon vechilyon shene gedole haddor hayu umippene tzara gedola yatzu venitchayyevu kelaya lammakom: 
Gedole hachachamim hayu menashshekin al techume eretz yisrael umenashshekin avaneha umitgalgelin al afarah. vechen hu omer <small>(Tehillim 102 15)</small> "ki ratzu avadecha et avaneha veet afarah yechonenu": 
Amru chachamim kol hashshochen beeretz yisrael avonotav mechulin. shenneemar <small>(yeshaya log kad)</small> "uval yomar shachen chaliti haam hayyshev bah nesu avon". afillu halach bah arba ammot zoche lechayye haolam habba. vechen hakkavur bah nitkapper lo. ucheillu hammakom shehu bo mizbach kappara. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 32 43)</small> "vechipper admato ammo". uvappuranut hu omer <small>(Amos 7 17)</small> "al adama temea tamut". veeno dome kolatto mechayyim lekolatto achar moto. veaf al pi chen gedole hachachamim hayu molichim metehem lesham. tze ulemad miyyaakov avinu veyosef hatztzaddik: 
Leolam yadur adam beeretz yisrael afillu beir sherubbah akkum veal yadur bechutza laaretz vaafillu beir sherubbah yisrael. shekkol hayyotze lechutza laaretz keillu oved avoda zara. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 26 19)</small> "ki gershuni hayyom mehistappeach benachalat Adonai lemor lech avod elohim acherim". uvappuranuyyot hu omer <small>(Yechezkel 13 9)</small> "veel admat yisrael lo yavou". keshem sheasur latzet mehaaretz lechutza laaretz kach asur latzet mibbavel lishar haaratzot. shenneemar <small>(yirmeya 27 22)</small> "bavela yuvau veshamma yihyu":
Mishneh Torah, Kings and Wars 6: En osin milchama im adam baolam ad shekkorin lo shalom. echad milchemet harshut veechad milchemet mitzva. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 20, 10)</small> "ki tikrav el ir lehillachem aleha vekarata eleha leshalom". im hishlimu vekibbelu sheva mitzvot shennitztauu bene noach alehen en horgin mehen neshama vahare hen lemas. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 20, 11)</small> "yihyu lecha lamas vaavaducha". kibbelu alehen hammas velo kibbelu haavdut o shekkibbelu haavdut velo kibbelu hammas. en shomin lahem ad sheyyekabbelu shenehem. vehaavdut sheyyekabbelu hu sheyyihyu nivzim ushefalim lematta velo yarimu rosh beyisrael ella yihyu kevushim tachat yadam. velo yitmannu al yisrael leshum davar shebbaolam. vehammas sheyyekabbelu sheyyihyu muchanim laavodat hammelech begufam umamonam. kegon binyan hachomot. vechozek hammetzudot. uvinyan armon hammelech vechayyotze bo. shenneemar <small>(Melachim 1 9, 15)</small> "veze devar hammas asher heela hammelech shelomo livnot et bet Adonai veet beto veet hammillo veet chomat yerushalami" <small>(Melachim 1 9, 19)</small> "veet kol are hammiskenot asher hayu lishlomo" <small>(Melachim 1 9, 20)</small> "kol haam hannotar min haemori" <small>(Melachim 1 9, 21)</small> "vayyaalem shelomo lemas oved ad hayyom hazze" <small>(Melachim 1 9, 22)</small> "umibbene yisrael lo natan shelomo aved ki hem anshe hammilchama vaavadav vesarav veshalishav vesare richbo ufarashav":
Veyesh lammelech lehatenot immahem sheyyikkach chatzi mamonam o hakkarkaot veyanniach kol hammittaltelin o hammittaltelim veyanniach hakkarkaot kefi ma sheyyatne:
Veasur leshakker bivritam ulechazzev lahem achar shehishlimu vekibbelu sheva mitzvot:

Veim lo hishlimu o shehishlimu velo kibbelu sheva mitzvot. osin immahem milchama vehorgin kol hazzecharim haggedolim. uvozzin kol mamonam vetappam. veen horgin ishsha velo katan shenneemar <small>(Devarim 20, 14)</small> "vehannashim vehattaf" ze taf shel zecharim. bamme devarim amurim bemilchemet harshut shehu im shear haummot. aval shiva amamin vaamalek shello hishlimu en mannichin mehem neshama shenneemar <small>(Devarim 20, 15)</small> "ken taase lechol" vegomer <small>(Devarim 20, 16)</small> "rak meare haammim" <small>(Devarim 20, 16)</small> "lo techayye kol neshama". vechen hu omer baamalek <small>(Devarim 25, 19)</small> "timche et zecher amalek". uminnayin sheeno medabber ella beellu shello hishlimu shenneemar <small>(Yehoshua 11, 19)</small> "lo hayta ir asher hishlima el bene yisrael bilti hachivvi yshve givon et hakkol lakchu vammilchama" <small>(Yehoshua 11, 20)</small> "ki meet Adonai hayta lechazzek et libbam likrat hammilchama et yisrael lemaan hacharimam". michlal sheshshalchu lahem leshalom velo kibbelu:

Shelosha ketavim shalach yehoshua ad shello nichnas laaretz. harishon shalach lahem mi sherotze livroach yivrach. vechazar veshalach mi sherotze lehashelim yashlim. vechazar veshalach mi sherotze laasot milchama yaase. im ken mippene ma heerimu yoshve givon. lefi sheshshalach lahem bakkelal velo kibbelu. velo yadu mishpat yisrael vedimmu sheshshuv en potchin lahem leshalom. velamma kasha haddavar lannesiim verau sherauy lehakkotam lefi cherev lule hashshevua. mippene shekkartu lahem berit vahare hu omer <small>(Devarim 7, 2)</small> "lo tichrot lahem berit" ella haya dinam sheyyihyu lemas avadim. vehoil uvetaut nishbeu lahen bedin haya sheyyehargu al shehitum lule chillul hashshem:

Ammon umoav en sholchin lahem leshalom shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23, 7)</small> "lo tidrosh shelomam vetovatam kol yamecha". amru chachamim lefi shenneemar <small>(Devarim 20, 10)</small> "vekarata eleha leshalom" yachol ammon umoav ken. talmud lomar lo tidrosh shelomam vetovatam. lefi shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23, 17)</small> "immecha yeshev bekirbecha" <small>(Devarim 23, 17)</small> "battov lo lo tonennu". yachol ammon umoav ken talmud lomar vetovatam. veaf al pi sheen shoalim bishlomam im hishlimu meatzmam techilla mekabbelin otan:

Keshetztzarin al ir letafsah. en makkifin otah mearba ruchoteha ella mishshalosh ruchoteha. umannichin makom labboreach ulechol mi sheyyirtze lehimmalet al nafsho. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar lo, 7)</small> "vayyitzbeu al midyan kaasher tzivva Adonai et mshe". mippi hashshemua lamdu shebbechach tzivvahu:

En kotztzin ilane maachol shechutz lammedina veen monin mehem ammat hammayim kede sheyyivshu. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 20, 19)</small> "lo tashchit et etzah". vechol hakkotzetz loke. velo bematzor bilvad ella bechol makom kol hakkotzetz ilan maachol derech hashechata loke. aval kotztzin oto im haya mazzik ilanot acherim. o mippene shemmazzik bisde acherim. o mippene sheddamav yekarim. lo asra tora ella derech hashechata:

Kol ilan serak muttar lakotz oto vaafillu eno tzarich lo. vechen ilan maachol shehizkin veeno ose ella davar muat sheeno rauy litroach bo muttar lakotz oto. vechamma yehe hazzayit ose velo yekutztzennu. rova hakkav zetim. vedekel shehu ose kav temarim lo yekutztzennu:
Velo hailanot bilvad. ella kol hameshabber kelim. vekorea begadim. vehores binyan. vesotem mayan. umeabbed maachalot derech hashechata. over belo tashchit. veeno loke ella makkat mardut middivrehem:

Tzarin al ayarot shel akkum shelosha yamim kodem hashshabbat veosin immahem milchama bechol yom veyom vaafillu beshabbat. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 20, 20)</small> "ad ridtah" vaafillu beshabbat. ben milchemet mitzva ben milchemet reshut:
Keshechonin chonin bechol makom. umi shenneherag bammilchama bammakom sheyyippol sham yikkaver. kone mekomo kemet mitzva:

Arbaa devarim patru bammachane. ochlim haddemay. ufeturim merchitzat yadayim battechilla. umeviin etzim mikkol makom. vaafillu metzaan telushim viveshim en makpidin al kach bammachane. vechen peturin millearev eruve chatzerot bammachane ella metaltelin meohel leohel umissukka lesukka vehu sheyyakkifu kol hammachane mechitztza gevoha asara tefachim kede shettihye reshut yachid kemo shennitbaer behilchot shabbat. veen mechitztza pechuta measara. ucheshem sheppeturin mikkol ellu bahalichatan kach peturin bachaziratan:

Veasur lehippanot betoch hammachane o al pene hassade bechol makom. ella mitzvat ase letakken sham derech meyuchedet lehippanot bah. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23, 13)</small> "veyad tihye lecha michutz lammachane":

Vechen mitzvat ase lihyot yated lechol echad veechad teluya im kele milchamto. veyetze beotah hadderech veyachpor bah veyippane vichasse. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23, 14)</small> "veyated tihye lecha al azenecha" vegomer. uven sheyyesh immahen aron uven sheen immahen aron kach hem osim tamid. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23, 15)</small> "vehaya machanecha kadosh":
